4018020.title: 天使之恋Online：国际版
4018020.short_description: 《天使之恋Online 国际版》是一款2D可爱奇幻风格的线上 MMORPG，主打高度自由的养成、多样玩法与跨国共玩体验，让新旧玩家都能轻松投入、长久游玩。可自由选择阵营、搭配技能来培养角色，创造出专属于个人的游戏风格。国际版更提供四倍速练等，加速角色成长，优化背包空间，让收集与探索更无负担。同时支援即时聊天翻译，可与全球玩家一同冒险。游戏装扮可由副本直接掉落，并追加分解、融合系统，将外观转化为实力。

4714810.title: 再战大极品+255
4714810.short_description: 一款自由打装备免氪金的传奇对战游戏，以其独特的游戏玩法和丰富多样的内容，吸引了众多玩家的关注。在游戏中，你将进入一个充满挑战和竞争的世界，与其他玩家展开激烈的对战，争夺珍贵的装备和资源，成为传奇战士的最终王者。

4315850.title: 白荣大学 0号馆
4315850.short_description: 『从大学地图上消失的校舍—0号馆』 白荣大学0号馆是一款以日本大学为舞台的废墟探索恐怖冒险游戏。 你将化身为灵异社团成员，前往禁止入内的「0号馆」进行采访。 在诡异的气氛中，0号馆的真相将逐渐浮出水面……究竟是什么？

3403590.title: Glimvale : My Mini Overworld
3403590.short_description: 《格林威尔》是一款融入了放置机制的温馨单人城市建造游戏。你可以管理、 装饰和发展一座迷人的多人在线游戏风小镇。 让冒险者们保持快乐， 按自己的节奏塑造这个世界。 作为这款游戏的GM， 这里由你说了算！

327070.title: Gloria Victis: Medieval MMORPG
327070.short_description: 《Gloria Victis》是一款侧重真实性的开放世界大型多人在线角色扮演游戏，背景设定为略带魔幻风格的中世纪。本游戏战斗系统无目标锁定机制，依赖玩家操作，玩家可在开放式的PVP战斗中争夺领土控制权。游戏的制造系统有深度而无所不包，经济系统由玩家主导，剧情成熟而宏大，画面写实而绚丽，向玩家呈现沉浸式的游戏体验。 游戏有两大阵营：居住在大草原上的自豪的中土人，以及住在寒冷北方又复仇心切的伊斯米尔人。玩家将选择一方加入，然后奔赴战场！

3986670.title: YOU ARE THE MONSTER
3986670.short_description: Ever wanted to be a giant monster rampaging through a city? Experience mindless chaos as you destroy all in your path, earning new abilities, new monsters and new ways to wreak havoc.

3541590.title: Arcadie II: Cold Lands
3541590.short_description: You are the Monarch. Choose between diplomacy and tyranny. Romance allies or enemies. Your decisions define your rule and the fate of those closest to you in this character-driven interactive tale.

2169930.title: R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos
2169930.short_description: 彻底颠覆传统的回合制战术策略体验，尽在《R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos》！本作首次登陆现代主机平台，集结系列两部作品。除了全面升级的视觉表现，还提供多条战役路线与分支任务，让战局发展随着你的每一次选择而改变！

3483510.title: 冒险家艾略特的千年奇谭
3483510.short_description: 融合像素图与3DCG的“HD-2D”系列首度推出全新动作RPG！

3975750.title: 城门血战
3975750.short_description: 在这款Rogue动作塔防游戏之中，世界危在旦夕，魔族步步紧逼，贝尔拉克城门是你和守军的最后防线。选择你的英雄，招募追随者，构建防线，并在战斗中获取资源不断强化你与随从，抵抗源源不断的敌军和末日Boss！

3354200.title: Bakso Simulator 2
3354200.short_description: Build, manage, and scale your very own Bakso restaurant in this first-person simulator. Design your layout, hire and train various staffs, upgrade your gear, expand your place and satisfy every customer to become the best Bakso empire in the world!

4196120.title: The Name I Wear
4196120.short_description: In an ancient riad once used as the base of a spy network, retrace the events and people tied to a forgotten tragedy. Your weapon? Names. Find them, write them, become them.

4794380.title: 千层登塔
4794380.short_description: 登塔客持琥珀金光，同道相随，在云雾山水间的千层楼阁中不断向上。 《千层登塔》以侧视像素呈现东方塔楼：屏风、横梁、曲折楼梯与自动战斗并存。你不必微操每场打斗——召唤与升级，剩下的交给登塔客与同道。金币来自击杀，成长来自你的选择：强化登塔客、培养同道、解锁楼层封锁与召唤扩容，让队伍在无限楼层里越爬越高。 Steam 页面上线后欢迎加入愿望单；开发中版本持续迭代，欢迎反馈建议。

4353630.title: 与夏日姐姐们的甜蜜时光
4353630.short_description: 时隔多年重返乡间，这个夏天优终于要与哈娜、莉娜、希娜三姐妹重逢了！不料母亲因急事匆匆返家，他将独自与三姐妹共度一段时光。宁静温馨的日式乡村里，等待他的会是怎样的夏日趣事呢？

3975500.title: 星之牧歌
3975500.short_description: 在神秘的世界中照顾人型圣灵的慢生活牧场经营模拟游戏。 种植作物、饲养圣灵（动物）， 或者与自己喜欢的角色进行交流，恋爱，结婚，孕育后代， 以属于自己的方式度过每日的快乐时光！

4681880.title: Dragon Kisser
4681880.short_description: Left alone as your little village’s last hope, you: Domingo, know what you must do to save your people and also pull a hot date, and that is to do what you know best: Romance the dragon attacking your home! Put your charisma to the test in this cheeky third-person soulslike boss battle!

4483120.title: Tales Beyond The Tomb - No Witnesses
4483120.short_description: A psychological horror anthology inspired by disturbing real-life cases. In No Witnesses, a simple road trip turns into a brutal fight for survival when two sisters cross paths with a ruthless serial killer stalking the highways at night.

3392490.title: Moon River
3392490.short_description: Moon River is a short RPG adventure with an emphasis on music and atmosphere. Perhaps some secrets too... Explore the remains of an quiet, empty world & find the river's end.

4791730.title: Market Simulator: Miami Beach
4791730.short_description: 在阳光明媚的迈阿密海滩从零开始建立你的超市帝国！游戏初期你只能睡在简陋的街头帐篷里，你需要亲自驾驶车辆前往批发商处提取货物，并将商品一件件亲手摆上货架，体验最真实的补货过程。在这个充满挑战的残酷街头经济中努力生存下来，组建家庭并让你的家人在街头帮你赚取额外现金以维持资金流转。在这个极其逼真的商业管理与生活模拟游戏中，通过精明的策略不断扩大你的零售业务，最终成功掌控并运营两家繁华的超市门店。

4753590.title: TEAM PANIC
4753590.short_description: TEAM PANIC 是一款电影化的合作冒险游戏，两名玩家将一起解开谜题，通过团队合作推进游戏，并体验充满乐趣的时刻。

2881370.title: 感谢你的投递
2881370.short_description: 《感谢你的投递》是一款剧情驱动的面试模拟游戏。经过15轮的面试，你与该岗位不太匹配。你被调剂为初级面试官，根据公司要求筛选候选人的简历，并发出合适的感谢信。

2899760.title: 樱花，萌放。-as the Night's, Reincarnation-
2899760.short_description: 这是一篇写给“魔法少女”的故事。拯救了人类未来的魔法少女们，历经苦战终于迎来幸福的结局。十年来迷惘着、烦恼着，继续前行。樱花飞舞之际，伴着“春”的归来，命运的齿轮再次开始转动。这是一篇并非为“魔法少女”而写的故事。我们的魔法，是不输给任何人的“想象力”。这一篇交织着他们愿望、幸福、离别与救赎的童话由此展开。

3939700.title: 海边宝藏小铺
3939700.short_description: 听，海浪退潮了！踩着柔软的细沙，循着探测器清脆的“滴滴”声，挖出深埋沙底的惊喜盲盒！将物件带回工坊，伴随毛刷“唰唰”擦拭的白噪音，体验极致解压的变废为宝。把锃光瓦亮的宝物摆进橱窗，在金币落袋的“叮当”声中用心经营你的海边小店。从贪婪酒店手中买回沙滩——别让浪漫变成私人领地，这片自由的海风归你守护！

4779560.title: Idle Startup
4779560.short_description: Build a tech company from a one-person garage into a global empire. Train six skills, automate the grind, prestige for permanent Founder bonuses, climb the leaderboards, and chase 50+ achievements in this clean, endlessly-scaling idle game — progress rolls on even while you're away.

4334840.title: 中生代黎明
4334840.short_description: 🦕《中生代黎明（Mesozoic Dawn）》是一款多人联机恐龙生存游戏。你将从一只脆弱的幼年恐龙开始，在危机四伏的史前荒野中，通过核心的“成长+产卵=进化”系统实现物种跨越式进化。

2776630.title: Skillwood
2776630.short_description: Skillwood is a relaxing woodcutter simulator inspired by survival simulators and incremental games. Chop wood, mine stone, trade with NPCs, upgrade forests, unlock new trees or new areas and prestige to do even better next run.

4056810.title: 东北往事
4056810.short_description: 本作深度改编自著名国民级IP《东北往事之黑道风云20年》。故事始于上世纪80、90年代东北暗流汹涌的街头，旧秩序正在改变。你，赵红兵，被卷入兄弟义气与地盘争夺的漩涡。与此同时，清纯如雪的高欢、泼辣似火的毛琴等红颜相继闯入你的生命；而情感的交织与江湖的算计接连上演。在权力与欲望面前，你的选择将彻底改写自己与他人的命运，走出独属于你自己的“道”

3929330.title: 释厄传
3929330.short_description: 《释厄传》是一款主打【后西游都市怪谈】的牌组构建式Roguelike！在这个神佛异化的世界里，利用逆天科技增强牌组，为卡牌打上专属词条。搭配1000+海量卡牌与300+法宝，构筑属于你的极致爽局！

4411600.title: 挂机破坏神 IdleDiablo
4411600.short_description: 《挂机破坏神 IdleDiablo》是一款以装备驱动为核心的类暗黑挂机刷宝游戏。无需繁琐操作，通过挂机的形式即可获取游戏内的所有资源，利用自身智慧合理搭配装备和技能即可击败各种强大的怪物屹立世界之巅！

4312850.title: FISH
4312850.short_description: FISH is a Platformer Run & Gun Shooter where you play as an armed FISH violently exploring through multiple levels. The game features a funny, unique stylized artstyle that could get a chuckle out of you!

3474700.title: Plant Nursery Simulator
3474700.short_description: 在这款轻松模拟游戏中经营温馨的植物苗圃。种植作物，补充货架，服务顾客。扩建温室，雇佣员工，装饰梦想店铺。适合喜欢治愈农场和模拟游戏的玩家。

1431300.title: SAND: Raiders of Sophie
1431300.short_description: 在架空的1910年，驾驶巨型“践踏者”穿越索菲的沙海展开搜刮。建造你高度可自定义的步行基地，单人或组队行动，收集战利品、武器与珍贵遗物。在历史与混乱锻造的程序生成荒漠中，与其他玩家激烈交锋。

2840000.title: Lumina Veil
2840000.short_description: Lumina Veil, a horror game with a modern twist! Step into the shoes of a popular streamer on a journey into a strange new game. As you dive deeper, you'll find yourself escaping the isolation of your own world, only to discover that the lines between fantasy and reality are beginning to blur.

4227400.title: 圣火守望者：共筑防线
4227400.short_description: 迎击铺天盖地的敌潮，筑起钢铁防线！在《圣火守望者：共筑防线》满屏怪物的围攻下，一边疯狂输出，一边即时建造塔楼、围墙与防御设施。搜刮随机神器，强化武器与英雄配置，死守竞技场中央的信标——只要信标未灭，战斗永不停歇！支持单人游玩，亦可2-4人热血联机。

2789810.title: 疯狂轮盘 / Bingle Bingle
2789810.short_description: 《疯狂轮盘》是一款超带劲的 “轮盘构筑” 策略游戏！在这里，你可以DIY专属自己的轮盘，把各种小球、筹码分配、代币、槽位和徽章玩转组合，触发让人肾上腺素狂飙的超强Buff！狠狠赚它个几百万、几千万筹码，赢下这场赌场对决吧！

2912550.title: 黑暗卷轴
2912550.short_description: 《黑暗卷轴》是一款奇幻主题的动作平台游戏，融合了弹幕射击类混乱场面与轻度Rogue的成长式玩法，集魅力、挑战与神秘于一身。

4102010.title: Idle Chapel
4102010.short_description: 这是一款暗黑奇幻风格的增量游戏，剧情围绕对抗崛起的邪教展开。寻找投靠邪神的信徒，运用雷霆手段使其回归光明正道。借助信徒的“虔诚值”来壮大自身，荡涤这片大地上的污秽——逐次点击，终结邪乱。

3759220.title: 森灵旅社
3759220.short_description: 为迷路的生灵，点一盏回家的灯。欢迎来到《森灵旅社》，一个被宁静守护，却又被一场“非自然”之疾悄然笼罩的村庄。在这里，你将经营一间温馨的动物旅社，亲手开垦田地、照料形形色色的动物，并与村民们一同重建社区。在悠闲的田园生活中，你将逐渐揭开村庄的秘密，用自己的双手，让森林重获新生！

2742710.title: 梦想翻新家
2742710.short_description: 给你一间旧屋，把它打造成梦想中的小家吧！拾起杂物、清理污渍、布置房间。这里是你专属的安全屋，没有既定规则和目标，一切都随你心意。把烦恼像垃圾一样丢掉，把坏心情像污渍一样擦去，让你的心灵和小屋一起焕然一新！准备好迎接你的新家了吗？一、二、三——欢迎回家！

1910680.title: Orb of Creation
1910680.short_description: Orb of Creation is a non-idle incremental-puzzle game in which you recreate the world with nothing but magic and ingenuity. Conjure resources, buy upgrades, and become an all-powerful wizard!

4562150.title: How To Grow a Black Hole
4562150.short_description: How To Grow a Black Hole 讲的是……嗯……如何养大一个黑洞。管理你的黑洞，喂食以增加质量，并防止灾难性坍缩。与全球玩家或好友竞争，打造最大的黑洞。也许你会成为第一名。

4221310.title: Chrono CCG
4221310.short_description: Chrono CCG is an indie game from genre veterans where time-traveling agents battle for control of history. Timelines shift mid-match, agents evolve, and deep strategy meets accessible play. For the community, by the community.

2654990.title: Mythic Love: Iberian Legends
2654990.short_description: 你以为和西班牙传说中的生物谈恋爱很简单吗？❤️‍🔥 小心：在 Mythic Love: 伊比利亚传说 里，赌上的可不只是你的心。

2454170.title: Doodle Dice Monsters
2454170.short_description: Doodle Dice Monsters is a strategic turn-based battling game where you draw your own characters! Form your six character dream team, then duel your friends in strategic multiplayer combat. Winner gets to steal one of the defeated Doodlemon for themself!

2458980.title: Dimhaven - The Lost Source
2458980.short_description: 准备好踏上冒险的旅途了吗？这款第一人称悬疑游戏由《Quern》的团队开发。走进晦港的世界，迎接挑战、探索未知、破解谜题，享受叙事驱动的体验。拿起相机，展现你的智慧！

4680930.title: Garbage Growth
4680930.short_description: Garbage Growth是一款简短的增量垃圾游戏，关于收集人们的垃圾、香蕉甚至婴儿来赚钱，并让世界污染得更严重。雇佣老鼠，增长你的污染, 让一切变得更糟!

1803140.title: 男孩与鹿
1803140.short_description: 在这款充满诗意、如同电影般的平台游戏中，一个离家出走的小男孩遇到了一只小鹿。随着友谊的不断加深，他们的能力也将提升。这段旅途的情感重量也在日益增长，达到“无声胜有声”的境界。

2803360.title: Project L33T: Founders Edition
2803360.short_description: Join the persistent open world of OZERSK! Choose your way to play on PvE or PvP servers, fight for precious loot and gear, and risk it all in a hostile environment. Die, lose all your gear and loot, then return to the same server in hopes of retrieving what you lost. This is your story!

3688130.title: 厨房清洁大师
3688130.short_description: 化身美食小英雄，向发霉污渍宣战！握紧你的高压喷枪，切换最精准的喷嘴，在这一场充满治愈感的街机冒险中，将冰箱里的黏腻污垢一扫而空。

4366330.title: Rift Wizard 3
4366330.short_description: Rift Wizard is a hardcore combat strategy roguelike and wizard simulator featuring an extremely deep build system. Customize your Wizard with more than 500 spells and magical artifacts. Blast, summon, or enchant your way through 20 levels of pure turn based chaos.

4639520.title: Mini Murder Mysteries
4639520.short_description: Solve cozy, crafty whodunits. Puzzle your way through nine unique investigations – and use your noggin to make intelligent deductions. Explore the evidence, scrutinize statements, and connect the dots.

2819400.title: Disc Golf Masters
2819400.short_description: The disc golf game built for people who actually play disc golf. Throw real licensed discs, pick your angles, play online, and chase the leaderboards. Made by disc golfers. Updated constantly.

2063480.title: Voltage High Society
2063480.short_description: 第一人称银河恶魔城，用拳头战斗。没有枪。探索爬满电子改造恐怖生物的监狱岛，从这座岛屿本身获取新能力，一路用拳头打出自由。灵感来自铁男:金属兽。

4768400.title: Idle Crown
4768400.short_description: 在这款中世纪放置RPG中,从农奴一路登顶为君主。修炼十五种技能,一砖一石营建领地,斩飞龙、屠利维坦,统御工人,步步为营直取王座。100项成就,39个排行榜,没有体力条,无需等待。

4716540.title: Maple Ridge
4716540.short_description: 妻子在一场事故中去世后，亚历克斯独自留在郊区的家中。这里的每一个细节，都让他想起过去。一个平凡的夜晚，很快演变成一连串诡异而令人不安的事件。

4453680.title: Dawn Bell
4453680.short_description: 睁开眼，映入眼帘的是一座陌生的古堡——。 《Dawn Bell》是一款横版2D恐怖冒险游戏。玩家将扮演一名失去记忆的少女，在阴森的古堡中展开探索。请利用收集到的道具与情报，解开重重谜团与机关，追寻少女失去的过去。 你的选择与行动将极大程度地影响故事的结局。这是一款拥有多结局系统的作品。 少女失去的过去究竟是什么？最终抵达的真相又是如何？在记忆之门开启的尽头，究竟有什么在等待着她——。

1466520.title: 崩坏之兆：饥荒
1466520.short_description: 1927年，超乎认知的阴森力量笼罩着冰冷的纽约。一名小男孩离奇失踪，身为记者的你被迫卷入这起骇人听闻的真实悬案。在这部洛夫克拉夫特式的交互游戏书中，你将徘徊于现实与梦境，通过勘查现场与话术博弈步步逼近真相。

3987560.title: 盛夏离与合
3987560.short_description: 毕业自驾游？不，是「心动修罗场」！ 《盛夏离与合》是现象级互动影像系列《完蛋！我被美女包围了！》IP的全新篇章。本次我们将填补“完蛋宇宙”时间线上的关键一块，带你回到那个承前启后、充满无限可能的毕业季，体验一段关于成长、抉择与命运交织的动人故事。 这段承前启后的夏日篇章，都会因你每一次的抉择，导向独一无二的盛夏结局。

4144680.title: DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round
4144680.short_description: 策略性十足的游戏系统、华丽必杀技与动态演出，以及个性鲜明的角色阵容——魅力满载的激斗盛宴，3D对战格斗动作游戏《DEAD OR ALIVE 6》震撼重启！

3954990.title: S.A.N.D.Y. - Beach Cleaner
3954990.short_description: 在这款简短、轻松又阴郁的游戏中，清理海滩上的垃圾！回收废弃物，升级你的机器人。探索新的领土。清理石油泄漏并拯救动物！

3529670.title: FULL METAL COFFIN
3529670.short_description: FULL METAL COFFIN is a 3D co-op submarine simulator. Crew your vessel with up to 4 players. Load the torpedoes, dodge incoming fire, and eliminate the enemy.

4323990.title: EMPULSE
4323990.short_description: EMPULSE 是一款即将上线的高速6v6移动射击游戏。跑墙、钩爪、Holojump、驾驶机甲、用 P.A.I.N.T. 征服 Freehold 的垂直街道。比对手跑得更快，否则只能被打倒。

4631110.title: Trashy Cashy
4631110.short_description: 一款流程约为 3-6 小时的短篇增量游戏，靠出售垃圾打造属于你的商业帝国。成为神秘的“Trashy Cashy”连锁品牌合伙人。拆开垃圾，将其发货，然后赚取高得离谱的利润。别问太多。听起来很简单，对吧？

4487840.title: Hard Truck 2: King of the Road
4487840.short_description: Hard Truck 2: King of the Road 是一款2000年的开放世界卡车游戏，属于早期塑造该类型的重要系列之一。运送货物，与其他司机竞争，并建立属于你自己的运输帝国。

4754800.title: Aura Farming
4754800.short_description: Aura Farming 是一款增量式爬塔游戏，玩家扮演不朽战士，拯救伙伴并提升灵气（Aura），以到达塔顶并拯救公主。

4446010.title: The First Million
4446010.short_description: 在这款放置类卡牌构筑游戏中，不断解锁新卡牌和升级，接二连三地发现颠覆游戏的制胜策略，赚到第一个 100 万，然后是更多个百万！

4557340.title: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift
4557340.short_description: A dream among the stars — or a nightmare. 1,000 colonists in the dark between stars. Every pragmatic decision rewrites who they are. Discover what your choices mean for humanity, for better or worse.

3859750.title: Lawn Care Simulator
3859750.short_description: Take Back the Yard in Lawn Care Simulator! Grab your mower and bring unruly lawns under control. From overgrown backyards to massive estates, cut through the chaos one blade at a time. Satisfyingly slice, edge, and clean your way to perfectly manicured greens — all in a day's mow.

3992580.title: 7 Nights with Vroombi
3992580.short_description: Play as Vroombi, a brave little robo-vacuum who needs to keep Lily's house nice and clean! Clean away dust, dirt and debris in this satisfying twist on an interactive cleaning simulator. What awaits little Vroombi at night? What is Lily scared of?

3924280.title: Pat the Cat
3924280.short_description: Your very own kitty — right on your desktop! A cozy idle game where you pet, feed, and play with a fluffy friend to earn purr points. Spend them on hats, toys, and cozy spots to sit. With hundreds of customization items, you can create a kitty that's truly yours — always by your side.

4049910.title: 核纪元
4049910.short_description: 《核纪元》是一款融合建造与战术射击的开放世界生存游戏。在这个后末世的世界中，玩家可以与好友一起探索广阔的废土，建设属于自己的庇护所基地，收集资源打造独特的武器装备。 游戏的核心玩法围绕高风险高回报的副本挑战展开：组建小队深入随机生成的危险区域，搜集珍稀物资并安全撤离。但要小心——死亡意味着失去所携带的全部装备，每一次探险都是勇气与策略的考验。 游戏最大的特色在于完全自定义的装备系统：所有武器的性能数值都由玩家亲手打造决定，没有固定的装备模板，每把武器都是独一无二的。

3690760.title: 牛仔镇杂货铺 | Wild West Supermarket Simulator
3690760.short_description: 在狂野西部经营一家杂货店。自定义并扩展你的商店。满足顾客不断变化的需求。你可以亲力亲为，也可以雇佣员工来补货或进行收银工作。体验在狂野西部经营超市的感觉。

4834070.title: Don't Sleep With The Fishes
4834070.short_description: How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.

3880410.title: Glisynth
3880410.short_description: Glisynth 是一款使用两种音符的节奏游戏。 键盘的 Q 行处理黄色音符，A 行处理白色音符。

4789820.title: galaksia online
4789820.short_description: Galaksia Online is an action-packed, 2D multiplayer space MMORPG blending retro pixel art aesthetics with mechanics. Forge alliances, custom-build your starships block by block, and engage in massive faction-based PvP wars or challenging PvE raid battles across dangerous stellar sectors.

4559140.title: Godius Eternal War
4559140.short_description: A classic 2D pixel MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online RPGs. Join nation wars, explore an open multiplayer world, trade with players, battle in PvP, and experience a community-driven adventure that has continued since 1999.

4740460.title: 十米爆爽超变
4740460.short_description: 无首充！无套路! 无强制消费! 耐玩性佳：海量特色玩法持续更新，长久陪伴乐趣无穷！ 匠心巨制：团队潜心一年重磅打造，热血体验诚意奉上！ 人气保障：专注打造火爆大服，激情永不落幕！

4800590.title: Supermarket Chaos
4800590.short_description: Supermarket Chaos 是一款治愈系整理模拟游戏，你将在杂乱的大型超市中整理 4,668 件商品。在轻松安静的氛围中，享受陈列带来的满足感。

4080030.title: The Message from Deep Space
4080030.short_description: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

4560490.title: 回放
4560490.short_description: 《回放》是一个硬核的文本类侦探解谜游戏，包含了近百条线索，玩家需要对线索进行详细审核并推理分析，最后找到案件的答案。

3278290.title: Feed The Pit
3278290.short_description: JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit. Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!

4173970.title: Procelio
4173970.short_description: Procelio is a multiplayer vehicle builder/shooter set amidst a proxy war on the red planet. Build and refine your custom machines from orbit, then pilot them in a distant war against CPU and enemy players.

4683470.title: 润之
4683470.short_description: 回到1929年，体验风云变幻的革命岁月。本作是一款以毛泽东第一人称视角展开的历史题材视觉小说，带您重温早期红军在艰难险阻中开拓进取的史诗篇章。 游戏专注于纯粹的叙事乐趣，摒弃了繁琐的数值养成，让您沉浸在图文并茂的互动阅读中。通过深度的视角代入，您将直击主角的内心世界，真切感受那个年代的理想与热血。 在推动历史车轮的关键节点，您的抉择至关重要。虽然主线剧情遵循史实，但不同的选项会触发独特的对话细节。面对生死攸关的重大事件，请务必谨慎思考——错误的决定将引发危机并直接导致游戏结束，唯有做出符合历史脉络的正确判断，才能引领队伍继续前行。 请加入这段沉浸式的时空之旅，在字里行间感受厚重的历史底蕴。

4186870.title: Beso's Shawarma
4186870.short_description: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.

4616840.title: Desk Space: Idle Spacefleet clicker
4616840.short_description: 在这款放置类太空游戏中壮大你的舰队。开采小行星、与空间站进行贸易、解锁升级赚取更多财富、部署海盗，甚至解锁[数据删除]。把它固定在桌面上，一边做着“更重要”的事，一边看着你的商业帝国日益壮大。

4156370.title: 杀毒少女
4156370.short_description: 《杀毒少女》是一款防御射击游戏。在游戏中，你将作为尖端反病毒组织「哨兵」的检查员，保护电脑免受病毒侵害。检查从网络传入的文件，让安全文件通过，并立即消灭病毒。你能否在不断进化的数字威胁中生存下来？

4634490.title: Master Healer Kale with useless party
4634490.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as a Healer in a party. Your main job is to keep your party alive. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from healing to party damage. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

3462790.title: Battle For Embolia
3462790.short_description: 《Battle For Embolia》是一款节奏快速的独立 MMORPG，拥有灵敏的战斗手感、有意义的成长系统和持续更新的内容。探索不断扩展的世界，挑战强大的 Boss，并通过反馈参与游戏开发。免费游玩，无付费取胜机制。

450540.title: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades
450540.short_description: Do you like hot dogs? How about horseshoes? Hand grenades? (everyone likes hand grenades) Anyway, we've got all that, and guns. SO MANY GUNS. So if you like ordnance, meat, and far too many groan-worthy puns, this is the VR sandbox game for you.

4724650.title: DEMON SIEGE
4724650.short_description: A retro-inspired Micro-FPS Bullet Heaven, where every powerup stacks infinitely. Become an unstoppable demon-slaying powerhouse with insane speed, massive jumps, multi-bullet weapons, and game-breaking builds.

4827240.title: Monster Breeder
4827240.short_description: Breed unique monsters where every baby inherits its looks AND stats from both parents. Hatch eggs, grow your collection, and send your creatures on turn-based adventures for gold and glory. With endless procedural designs, no two monsters are ever the same. How powerful can your bloodline become

2209900.title: Moonlight Peaks
2209900.short_description: 在《Moonlight Peaks》中体验吸血鬼的生活！掌握药水制作和咒语施放的艺术，悉心照料你的超自然农场，并与本地狼人、女巫和美人鱼成为好友——甚至坠入爱河。永恒唾手可得！

4133940.title: Tiny Frontier
4133940.short_description: Hide as anything. Paint it to match. The whistle will give you away anyway. A multiplayer prop hunt where Hiders disguise as world objects and hand-paint their camouflage, while Hunters sweep the level with scanners, washers, and capture tools to drag them out. Up to 16 players.

4742610.title: Truck Maxxing
4742610.short_description: Plow, Shoot, or throw saw blades at swarms of enemies in this truck based Roguelite action game! Tons of upgrade options per run with each run being unique and challenging. Earn scrap after each run to purchase cosmetics and customize your truck!

4886660.title: 海鸥灯塔Seagull Lighthouse Demo
4886660.short_description: 在一座灯塔里读信、回信、等信。没有倒计时，没有排名，没有任务。只有一片海，一群会送信的海鸥，和一些不知道什么时候漂来的瓶子。瓶子里装着陌生人的人生。你的回信可能会影响他们的故事。在这个焦虑快节奏的年代里，让自己慢下来。

4729470.title: Chrono Survivors - Arena Survival Roguelite
4729470.short_description: Survive waves of enemies as a time-bending chronomancer! An action roguelite with auto-attack, XP collection, upgrade choices, and class-based ultimate abilities

4476350.title: The Beekeeper
4476350.short_description: A fast systemic strategy puzzle about ecological scarcity and timing. Place limited hives on a hex grid, protect fragile species, and optimize under pressure knowing some losses may be inevitable.

4769520.title: Bahast
4769520.short_description: A dark fantasy idle ARPG where you prepare a character, send them into automated PvE runs, collect loot, craft stronger gear, and shape your build through skills, passives, and long-term progression.

4853960.title: 十三张: 死斗&肉鸽
4853960.short_description: Thirteen: Risk & Rogue 是一款融合 roguelike 生存与十三张扑克策略的卡牌对战游戏。你将带着有限的筹码，闯过多关挑战，每一关都是一场真正的脑力博弈——活下来，就是胜利。

4905910.title: BLIGHTEN Demo
4905910.short_description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

4856290.title: ZodiacLottery Demo
4856290.short_description: 一个彩票 Roguelike 游戏. 移动动物, 打造属于你的中奖彩票, 并结合强力遗物与丰富的协同效果, 赢取惊人的巨额奖金!

4915990.title: Golfcremental Demo
4915990.short_description: BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY! Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

2883030.title: Vultures
2883030.short_description: Vultures is a single-player, real-time factory simulation where you construct and manage an ambitious manufacturing operation in a volatile and chaotic market that will eventually crush you and your dreams.

4847340.title: 要塞实验室 试玩版
4847340.short_description: 要塞实验室(Fort Laboratory)是一款2D对冲式塔防/轻度ROGUE游戏，玩家需在游戏中建设基地、武器和工厂来抵御成群上百的敌人。收集各种不同的物品和建筑，构筑独特的防御体系，保护核心直至攻击结束。

4900240.title: The Essence of Thievery Demo
4900240.short_description: The Essence of Thievery is an incremental game with a focus on exploration, discovery, and travel. Command your thief underlings to discover, steal, and wield the power of Essences to push back the Silent Fog and save the world.

4863340.title: House Of Trauma Demo
4863340.short_description: From Shooteo's YouTube Channel comes House of Trauma, a first person horror game where you play as Gabriel, a CPS worker assigned to a possible case of abuse of a child named David at a mysterious home. You soon find that this house hides much darker secrets than you could've ever imagined.

4885280.title: Neural Descent Demo
4885280.short_description: A difficult 2D platformer built around movement mastery

4876610.title: Left Not Right Demo
4876610.short_description: 左手操作左边，右手操作右边，可同时进行! 这是不需要朋友的单机游戏，可放心进行。 可用双手同时移动两个角色，试图完成逃离地下研究室。

4081200.title: Chessman Adventures
4081200.short_description: Every move matters in this chess-inspired tactical adventure. Lead three heroes and outsmart the undead.

4726020.title: YEET! The Elite
4726020.short_description: Play as Earth itself in this chaotic arcade action game where you grab elite figures and YEET them into the Sun while dodging UFOs and surviving frantic planetary swats from the Moon, Venus, and Mercury.

4765310.title: Day Breaker - Awakening Code
4765310.short_description: As Mia a resistance scout you investigate a remote island after a blackout. Discover a prototype AI that equips you with a suit, boosting your skills, combat and crafting. Face two advanced AI Agents crucial to Nex AI plan as you upgrade your abilities and fight to stop Nex from wiping out humanity.

4902070.title: 超魔球！ホームランダービー Demo
4902070.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

2749950.title: Esports Manager 2026
2749950.short_description: 建立并领导您自己的职业电子竞技组织。招募球员、管理合同、培养人才、聘请员工、打造品牌，并在深度逼真的管理模拟中争夺冠军头衔。

3821830.title: 3D剧本杀 焦黑的你
3821830.short_description: 《焦黑的你》是一款可供四人挑战的3D剧本杀。 故事以一座远离尘嚣的贵族别邸为舞台，一起离奇的烧杀事件在此发生。 玩家将追体验嫌疑人的记忆，在宅邸中展开探索，收集证物，并通过全员讨论来锁定真凶。

4924670.title: Meow Paw Cursor : 喵爪光标 Demo
4924670.short_description: 一只软萌的大喵爪追随着你的指尖，踏上每一次点击的旅程。 告别沉闷的默认箭头，让桌面成为一只活生生的猫咪游乐场——每一帧移动都带着肉垫的温度，每一次点击都像喵喵在操作。 小而轻，却让整个桌面都活了起来。喵爪光标 试用版

4817530.title: 蘑菇农场
4817530.short_description: 在你自己舒适的农场种植神奇蘑菇！培育30种独特菌类，收集孢子，并在森林漫步中发现稀有真菌。支持31种语言的放置休闲游戏。

4923670.title: 麦田幸存者 Demo
4923670.short_description: 《麦田幸存者》是自动开火的动作 Rogue-like。武器锁定最近敌人,你只需走位闪避、抉择每次升级的武器与被动组合。麦田、雪原、熔岩、沙漠、虚空 —— 五张主题地图节奏各异,还能在商店里画一张自己的地图当战斗地面。单局 5-20 分钟,武器进化、进化体建造与永久属性加成让战死不白死。

4655610.title: Robo Rig
4655610.short_description: Robo Rig is a 3D, top down, Extraction Bullet Hell where you play as a fully customizable robot. You build your robot, enter battle and destroy enemies, gain coins and collect parts, then you must extract and build an even more powerful robot with the newly acquired parts!

4297450.title: 魔法少女ファイナルピンクスター
4297450.short_description: 跳跃动作射击游戏。不擅长飞行的魔法少女。在躲避敌人触手的同时飞行并击败敌人。全6关卡+无尽模式

4401900.title: 我主沉浮-Master of Fate's Tides Demo
4401900.short_description: 这是一部AVG故事视觉游戏小说，增加了ARPG的2.5D游戏玩法。你将成为北凉王朝的第三位皇子。你可以通过不同的选择来控制剧情情节方向，解锁NPC偏好，并解锁新的故事情节。

4907990.title: Throughput Demo
4907990.short_description: A hyper-abstract city sim where every entity pathfinds to the beat and the soundtrack pulses with your city. Zone, build, watch it breathe.

4922710.title: Thugz VS Zombies Demo
4922710.short_description: Build your block defense, recruit wild THUGZ, earn cash, upgrade your crew, and survive the first boss fight in this cartoony tactical zombie defense demo.

4443070.title: Trump Ballroom Blitz
4443070.short_description: 拆除特朗普宴会厅。最快时间登上全球排行榜！ 找到挖掘机，尝试尽快摧毁特朗普宴会厅。 使用 WASD 移动，使用鼠标移动相机。

4888190.title: 故地春寻 Demo
4888190.short_description: “桥本可以连接一切，过去与未来，繁荣与衰败...可...断掉的桥呢？” 这是一款由新人制作团队weave为大家带来的galgame。在本游戏中，玩家将作为男主角“辛诚”，与本作女主角——桥神“古桥”相遇。玩家可以在游戏中通过选择不同选项触发不同剧情，沉浸式体验与古桥在一起的日常，并通过点击屏幕浏览文本，欣赏配音，鉴赏插画cg，与古桥在平凡的每日中加深了解，相互理解，并一起开启一段令人激动的寻找之旅，寻找那些遗忘的，隐藏的事物。 希望大家可以在我们的游戏中获得欢乐，同时也欢迎大家向我们提出不足。 欢迎大家来体验。

4858890.title: Project Refactor Demo
4858890.short_description: 选择注定和失去相伴——那失去之后，还剩下什么？规划每周时间，在事件抉择中经历一段关于选择与和解的人生。

4838190.title: 古都千年 Demo
4838190.short_description: 一款以丝绸之路为背景的小镇模拟经营游戏。玩家化身小镇主人，规划生产，应对寒冬酷暑与异域疫病的动态挑战。居民有完整的人生轨迹，生老病死皆在你的见证中。派遣探险队贸易，邂逅历史名人，感受跨越千年的丝路兴衰。Demo包含前期核心经营与贸易玩法。

4823800.title: Observe. Demo
4823800.short_description: Your character is named Mason. After a tragic event, you wake up in the middle of the night unable to leave your room. Your computer screen lights up with 3 levels, only 1 is unlocked currently. Complete the first level to unlock the next.

4444690.title: Confessional Simulator Demo
4444690.short_description: You're the new priest at St. Augustine's. Sinners kneel on the other side of the screen and tell you everything. Forgive them and your Faith grows. Work the guilt and the donations roll in. Push it too far and the Bishop starts listening. A voiced dark comedy about other people's sins.

4533740.title: Project Doll: My Only Wish
4533740.short_description: Project Doll is a Single player, Soft horror, Exploration game set in a rural Japanese school beset by a supernatural curse that has you finding clues, solving puzzles and uncovering the cause of the curse.

4914160.title: Borrow or Rob Demo
4914160.short_description: 一款建立在时间倒转之上、洋溢 90 年代复古模拟质感的科幻 roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。与倒转时间发起攻击的敌人交战——随后由你倒转时间，在逆转的战场上作战。在初次交锋中收集线索，再用自己的策略展开反击。

4856250.title: Spire of Legends
4856250.short_description: Ascend a mysterious spire in this deckbuilding roguelike. Master unique characters with passive abilities, active skills, and powerful ultimates while building decks, collecting relics, and battling through ever-changing encounters.

4279050.title: 得儿猫（Stinky cat）
4279050.short_description: 一只脸长得“很别致”的奶牛猫，被那个造型愚蠢的飞船绑架到了赛博空间，头上还被吸了个电子马桶搋子！在这款结合了推箱子与炸弹人机制的休闲解谜游戏中，你需要规划路线推动箱子，引爆炸弹粉碎障碍，甚至吞下鲱鱼罐头。躲避疯狗与UFO的追击，在一场场荒诞的爆炸中杀回现实世界！

4904610.title: Memoirs Demo
4904610.short_description: In a treacherous place where overflowing emotions are your weapons, descend into the darkness of a broken mind. Fight through twisted memories and survive your deepest fears in this psychological Top-Down arena shooter.

4848340.title: 致命勇士
4848340.short_description: 《致命勇士》是一款刷宝动作RPG。踏入魔幻的异世界，挑战无尽怪物、危险秘境与强大首领，收集海量装备与稀有战利品，打造专属于你的终极流派。

4798960.title: Demon Protocol
4798960.short_description: Lock On. Light Up. Lay Waste. Demon Protocol is a retro arcade space shooter with 25 waves of relentless enemies, 4 brutal bosses, and power-ups to keep you fighting. Choose your difficulty and see how far you can push before the demons win.

4775200.title: Quattro Synchro
4775200.short_description: Quattro Synchro is a roguelike puzzle game where a familiar Connect Four-style board meets endless strategy. Build combos, collect powerful upgrades, and master ever-changing racks where gravity, physics, and the rules themselves can shift.

4400900.title: Cursed Cargo
4400900.short_description: Cursed Cargo 是一款在线合作喜剧恐怖游戏，环境与怪物一样危险。最多可与 4 名玩家组队，使用基于物理的工具运输不可预测的货物。使用近距离语音聊天进行协作，但要小心——那些存在始终在倾听。

4611050.title: Flamel's Requiem
4611050.short_description: Family, power, and survival collide in this atmospheric horror adventure. Craft, fight, and uncover the truth before your illness—and your pursuer—claims you.

3990210.title: Poolar Bear
3990210.short_description: 《Poolar Bear》是一款极简滑行解谜游戏，包含 100 个关卡。引导好奇的北极熊穿越平静的泳池，利用漩涡传送门、反弹植物、气流风扇，并避开鲨鱼和食人鱼等危险。简单的方向键操作搭配舒适的设计，带来轻松又烧脑的冒险。

4918970.title: 矿工生存者 试玩版
4918970.short_description: 采矿、建造、生存、防御。一款快节奏的幸存者塔防游戏。采掘黄金，建造防御塔与无人机，在千变万化的地下世界中对抗成群的敌人并击败强大的首领。

4877610.title: VORTEX-G: Anti-Gravity Racing & Track Editor Demo
4877610.short_description: Experience the speed of VORTEX-G for free. This demo features Arcade Mode with 3 tracks and 2 fully customizable ships.

4417490.title: 几何防线
4417490.short_description: 《几何防线》是一款受经典广告小游戏启发的几何射击游戏。每通过一个关卡，你都将面对不同的强化选择，通过随机词条组合提升能力。不断突破防线，尝试各种成长路线，体验简单、爽快且充满变化的战斗。

4891310.title: Froggy's Adventures Demo
4891310.short_description: Play the free opening chapter of Froggy's Adventures! Create your own frog and explore cozy Lilypad City — recover the stolen Golden Fly, brave the pitch-dark Mossy Caverns for the sunken crown, and drive back the Oozing to become a hero. About 20 minutes. Wishlist the full 5-chapter adventure!

4735570.title: Night Shift Demo
4735570.short_description: 游乐园中的街机射击游戏：击败一波又一波的敌人，清除公园中的不速之客。解锁各种武器--升级后它们将拥有特殊能力。这是你的第一班岗--你能保护好公园里的景点吗？

4522470.title: Topidia: The Last Badge
4522470.short_description: Become the greatest explorer, find the last badges you are missing, and most importantly, be the first to discover Topidia!

4522440.title: Beerserker: The Stolen Brew
4522440.short_description: Beerserker is a modern fast-paced arcade game and comical twist. Blinded by the legendary dwarven ale’s taste, Ragna aims to retrieve this masterpiece from the grasp of the gods. Will you be able to make your way through a crowded dwarven brewery? Or end up crushed by their ranks?

4522460.title: NAOS-01: The Quiet Sector
4522460.short_description: Trapped behind enemy lines as the Naos scientific-military base descends into chaos, Helios evades capture without reinforcements. Surrounded by hostile patrols, they must move silently through the shadows, infiltrate occupied zones, and send a distress signal before Naos falls completely.

4522430.title: Nohmen: Blood Rites
4522430.short_description: Return to your ancestral castle as Kento, a warrior bound by duty, and confront the force corrupting your clan. Battle possessed enemies in fast-paced combat focused on timing, dodges, and counters. Solve puzzles, explore cinematic spaces, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening all.

3706280.title: Drunk Dad vs Family
3706280.short_description: Drunk Dad vs Family 是一款混乱的 4v1 聚会游戏，家庭成员必须在醉酒的爸爸将房子变成一片混乱之前，把他哄睡！

3914980.title: 50 Years Classic
3914980.short_description: 50 Years Classic is a minimalist turn-based strategy game where you can choose from a variety of nations, each with its own unique feature. The game offers fast, engaging gameplay with high replayability. This is a free version of the game "50 years".

4794570.title: 宝石我来捡，你只管揍人: Blood & Blessing
4794570.short_description: 这是一款快节奏的2D生存动作Roguelike游戏！你流血奋战，她却边治疗边抱怨。消耗你的生命值去砸碎无尽的敌群，与贪婪的AI牧师在极端的资源置换中求生，并靠兼职‘赏金猎人’来赚钱购买你的技能！

4282880.title: Your Price, Your Honor.
4282880.short_description: “Your Price, Your Honor.” is a game where you control the choices of a judge who is getting close to retirement. You must manage the public’s tolerance for injustice… and your own wallet.

4727270.title: Puzzles: Fish
4727270.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

562770.title: Enigmo
562770.short_description: Award-winning physics puzzle game now in spatial format! Get your brain in gear!

4727280.title: Puzzles: Space Cats
4727280.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

3946050.title: DISJOINED Demo
3946050.short_description: Welcome to the world of DISJOINED. The story of the universe has been completed, and all that exists now is the Infinite Mall at the End of Time. With hope, it's up to you to move forward.

4772820.title: Problem Space Demo
4772820.short_description: Venture forth through this puzzle game across space. Use your command terminal to guide the Onlooker interstellar probe through treacherous galaxies to explore the farthest reaches of the universe. Avoid asteroids, perform research tasks, and weave through the stars!

4828210.title: SMTHNG WRNG
4828210.short_description: Men are mysteriously vanishing in a small, provincial town. A newly arrived guy finds himself trapped in the center of eerie events when someone he believed was gone forever suddenly reappears. What kind of ruthless system is behind this, and who can be trusted?

4373150.title: Nerds Revenge
4373150.short_description: 书呆子——多年被殴打、羞辱和嘲笑。现在他们回来复仇了。但肌肉男不会轻易放弃这座城市。选择你的阵营，加入这场全面争夺控制权的战争！

4689290.title: SiegeBlock
4689290.short_description: Clear lines, summon troops and defend your kingdom in a medieval falling-block puzzle-defense roguelite. Play solo, team up locally with a friend, or battle in 1v1 versus with rival boards, armies and debuffs.

4822060.title: 漂流工厂 Demo
4822060.short_description: 收集资源、研究科技、扩建平台、搭建传送带网络，在危机四伏的海上世界中生存并发展。利用自动化生产线解放双手，让工厂持续运转，最终造出星舰前往火星.

4787290.title: Chief of the Valley
4787290.short_description: Build a PC company from a one-person operation in the dawn of computing to an industry titan in the modern era. Manage staff, secure contracts, research technology, and ship products all while keeping yourself from financial ruin. The Valley is an unforgiving place.

4796940.title: 1 day poison in world
4796940.short_description: A first-person 3D survival adventure where you explore poisoned levels, activate pressure plates, avoid hazards and enemies, and reach the exit before time runs out.

4862010.title: Trying to Wake Up
4862010.short_description: Trying To Wake Up is a 3D platformer focused on storytelling and atmosphere. Journey through a dreamlike world, overcome simple obstacles, and gradually uncover the mysteries behind an emotional and immersive adventure.

4905200.title: Blek and the Endless Keep Demo
4905200.short_description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

4909370.title: ChompBurg Demo
4909370.short_description: Control an acolyte of Dracula through the mazeburg, collecting villagers and avoiding the hunters to break the score, customize power ups to trigger your combos and become the hunter, transform Chompburg into a point making machine and discover dopamine blasting synergies!

4700250.title: Sisyphus's Worst Day (again)
4700250.short_description: Build traps, manipulate the environment, and engineer the perfect loop to keep Sisyphus from ever reaching the summit in this comedic isometric 3D puzzle game.

4836100.title: Time Dilation Lab
4836100.short_description: An easy to use, fully adjustable space lab with Einstein's special relativity equations in a three-spacecraft configuration. Play around with time dilation and relativistic Doppler effects in space at your own pace. Multiple viewpoints in 3D, real-time, with data export functionality.

4633320.title: Gridhammer
4633320.short_description: Gridhammer is a tactical plate battler where two players draft from one shared pool of 45 plates. Place plates on a grid, capture by matching higher corner values, and chain cascading flips. Every plate you draft is one your opponent loses.

4838940.title: Above the Sun
4838940.short_description: Yugemaru, a self-proclaimed gal mechanic, sets out to reach the top of the Acid Tower using the power of steam. With the eerie acid closing in, climb the randomly generated platforms — climb, climb, CLIMB! ...Wait — did I just fall? LOL.

4101270.title: Just Pool
4101270.short_description: Just Pool is a minimalist 8-ball pool game. Score all your balls to win the match, play with friends or solo.

1835420.title: AHA Asset Horde Arena
1835420.short_description: Survive against endless hordes of enemies, collect powerful ability cards, create crazy combinations of builds and survive for 25 minutes under the onslaught of thousands of monsters alone or with friends.

4724520.title: Lost Galaxy: Survivors Demo
4724520.short_description: Defend massive interdimensional portals against relentless alien swarms in this fast-paced sci-fi top-down survival shooter.

4916210.title: Pixel Exorcist Demo
4916210.short_description: Play as a young Exorcist tasked with saving a cursed town in this 90's pixel art inspired Investigation-puzzler, with the top down visuals of the RPG's of that era.

4732390.title: The Wandering Wyrm
4732390.short_description: Wandering Wyrm is a high-fantasy visual novel with a focus on cooking. Run a tavern on the back of a dragon and serve a variety of unique adventurers. Influence the story with the food you serve!

2618160.title: Legends of Starkadia
2618160.short_description: Legends of Starkadia is a quirky turn-based RPG full of quick-time events and action-packed adventure! The Starkadian Empire is under attack by one of their own and it’s up to a team of unlikely heroes to assist the resistance to restore peace by defeating Niko and his legion of interstellar armies.

4268060.title: Piano Trauma - Stress Deluxe
4268060.short_description: 款关于驾驶钢琴去演奏音乐会的合作游戏。

4773390.title: Dreaming With Sharks
4773390.short_description: Play as a Shark name Doc who is granted wonderful surgical abilities after given strange pills from a mysterious man. Doc excels at his surgeries, but suffers wild hallucinations. Progress each day with a variety of minigames and modifiers in order to become a surgery master!

4856850.title: Aéro: speedrun labyrinthe
4856850.short_description: A third-person speedrun puzzle game set in a mysterious sci-fi laboratory. Complete experimental rooms, master your route, improve your best time, follow Aves’ voiced guidance, and search for the 12 hidden bonus eggs.

4697170.title: Memo R.I.P.
4697170.short_description: 这是一款第一人称卡牌游戏，恐怖并非持续出现：它只会在对局决定时降临。支持1–4名玩家实时语音聊天，包含900多个动态事件、诅咒式进程，以及等待挑战的最终Boss。

3515060.title: ホロウソロウ
3515060.short_description: Hollow Sorrow is a dark yet heartwarming 2D exploration adventure game where you confront your lost past.

4873170.title: Explosive Escape
4873170.short_description: Explosive Escape is a fast-paced drifting challenge where every move can be your last.

4872970.title: Double Driver
4872970.short_description: Double Driver is a fast-paced arcade driving game that puts your coordination to the test.

4876460.title: 抓娃娃机任务 DEMO
4876460.short_description: 一款再现日本抓娃娃机的模拟游戏。足不出户，也能体验到游戏厅特有的那种绝望感。运用各种技巧赢取奖品。解锁奖品和关卡，成为抓娃娃机高手吧。

4841480.title: Chicken Battlefield
4841480.short_description: 《鸡群战场》是一款混乱的Roguelite游戏，你将指挥一群装备精良的鸡，与敌对派系展开全面战争。武装你的鸡群，保卫你的基地，在敌人无情的进攻中生存下来，并通过独特的升级、武器和战场特性来调整你的战略。

4881510.title: Sharp Stock Demo
4881510.short_description: Sharp Stock 是面向游戏开发者和美术师的本地资产管理工具。支持预览 3D 模型、Spine 动画、音频、图片和字体，提供纹理图集打包、精灵图切分、标签搜索和本地磁盘工作流。

4851270.title: Deadwood House
4851270.short_description: A co-op first-person horror game. Search a mysterious wooden house suspended above the clouds, complete objectives, and escape before the creatures hunting you close in. Play solo or with friends across multiple difficulty levels.

4871420.title: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening
4871420.short_description: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening is a sci-fi idle progression game where you rebuild a shattered colony ship, restore lost systems, automate production, and uncover the mystery hidden within the Ark’s damaged memory.

4753990.title: Type Hype
4753990.short_description: Type to the beat. Letters fall from the top of the screen — type the right keys to the synthwave beat. 54 training levels teach every key, 15 themed exhibition levels push you to mastery, 4 free-roam modes never end. Expert typists welcome.

4909770.title: Iron Ledger Demo
4909770.short_description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

4855940.title: Kings Call 2 Demo
4855940.short_description: 在这款《Kings Call 2》中，你将化身为银鹭岭领主！收集卡牌召唤强大生物、释放绚丽法术、击败凶猛怪物，穿越区域守护自己的王国。游戏支持自由构建专属卡组，展开深度策略对战，还能结交盟友团队协作，同时提供快速对局与自由交易的乐趣。四大职业各展神通：法师擅长范围伤害与控制敌军，牧师以治疗和圣光守护盟友，游侠精准打击并掌控节奏，战士则提升团队输出。卡牌品质从白到金，士兵分普通与精英，准备值归零即可部署。来吧，挑战智力与勇气的极限，守护你的王国！

4887220.title: 大剑25k：邪恶入侵 Demo
4887220.short_description: 本游戏是一个动作冒险游戏。你的目标是消灭所有能看到的异形生物，可以使用盾牌和剑技，有两类不同的招式，有不同的效果，可以弹反，杀死敌人可以回复一些状态，持续的杀戮才能使你活下去。

4868590.title: operation
4868590.short_description: Operation is a zombie horror action game where players enter a sealed operation zone, fight infected enemies, complete mission objectives, and survive with teammates in a dark and dangerous environment.

4389170.title: Fugaz
4389170.short_description: Play a flute to solve puzzles and unlock secrets, looking for an exit of a dark place before the darkness consumes everything. In this dark immersive horror puzzle game, knowledge is key to put the pieces together. No music experience required.

3873040.title: Last Breath
3873040.short_description: Last Breath is a solo/cooperative terraforming survival game. Dig through terrain, build powerful machines, and restore life to a dead planet. Work together to survive, automate, and reshape the world from the ground up, literally.

4829530.title: DOI: Defense Shooter
4829530.short_description: Defend the base and gather energy!

4733840.title: Little Battle Simulator
4733840.short_description: Create the battlefield of your dreams and fight! Monsters, vast armies, rivers and forests, multiple teams… Anything goes! Create your own battle in "Sandbox". Witness the chaos in "Random Battle", Achieve the highest possible score in "Challenge"

4859790.title: OUTWORKS
4859790.short_description: 建造高耸的立体要塞，守住防线。层层叠楼、立起城墙，并按高度部署炮塔，抵御从四面逼近核心、不断升级的地面与飞行机械大军——然后看着一座坍塌的高塔将一切一同拖垮。一款精炼、霓虹、纯代码打造的基地防御 Roguelite。

4907050.title: Vapor Storage Manager Demo
4907050.short_description: 一款智能、安全的清理游戏垃圾的实用工具。Vapor Storage Manager 可帮您寻找并清除已删除游戏中被遗忘的数 GB 着色器缓存、Steam 创意工坊模组以及残留文件。在 PC

4917990.title: Waterpump Simulator Demo
4917990.short_description: Start with a simple water pump and turn a small roadside stand into a thriving business. Sell drinks, upgrade your equipment, unlock new products, improve your workflow, and serve an ever-growing number of customers as you build your own successful roadside business from the ground up.

4868610.title: Tamespire
4868610.short_description: A cozy-dark creature-collection roguelite deckbuilder. Tame Spirelings, fuse their moves into a living deck, and climb a Spire that rebuilds itself every run. Evolve your team, master five clashing elements, and push your luck through endless Ascensions.

4542710.title: ZeroOut
4542710.short_description: Complete puzzles by zeroing out the board! This is achieved by placing the pieces onto the board. Once the piece is placed, the numbers of the affiliated squares on the board will decrease based on the number of the piece. Pieces may need to be rotated or flipped.

4844330.title: Throne of Trials
4844330.short_description: A hardcore turn-based boss rush RPG where preparation is key. Assemble a 4-member party from 15 classes, and customize them with dropped gear and skills to defeat rule-breaking bosses. Read enemy intents, manage hate, and execute tactical interrupts in this deep strategic experience.

4874010.title: Arsica: Echoes of Ars
4874010.short_description: Arsica is a 2D Platformer RPG where you play as a demon hunter carrying a power no army ever had. Four demons claimed the lands. Mankind retreated to its last shelter. You are not here to survive. You are here to end it. Build your team, forge your gear, hunt every monster and four demon.

4810930.title: Down The Stairs: The Game
4810930.short_description: Down The Stairs: The Game is a physics-based ragdoll challenge where every clean stair run, brutal fall, shaft setup, and ghost race pushes you toward a better score. Stay in control, hit the beams, beat other players’ ghosts, and master the descent.

4872590.title: Burger Maker
4872590.short_description: A puzzle game where you combine randomly falling ingredients on 10 turntables to fill customer orders. Preparing stock in advance is just as important as filling orders. New menu items are added as your rating climbs, making things increasingly hectic. Use combos and chains to reach 5 stars!

4752540.title: Very Disco, Disco Very! Demo
4752540.short_description: 规划你的行动，锁定计划，然后看着混乱展开。 《Very Disco, Disco Very!》是一款支持1–8人的战术派对游戏，所有玩家同时编程自己的行动。每回合选择一个6步序列并锁定，但完美的策略往往无法幸存。

4539870.title: Khaldun: Text Based Strategy
4539870.short_description: Khaldun is a medieval-themed ASCII graphics kingdom management game. Take part in realistic war simulations and decide every detail of your kingdom, from its economy to its demographics! Your decisions will shape the life of a nation. Rise or be lost to history...

4167650.title: Polyomino
4167650.short_description: Polyomino is a falling block roguelike where you build powerful synergies through boons, powerups, and upgrades. Face tricky bosses, use unique powerups, drop special Polyominoes and craft unique builds in a unique, endlessly replayable climb to the top.

4235660.title: Heavy Wake
4235660.short_description: Explore a cursed island in a short dark-fantasy deckbuilding RPG. Recruit strange survivors, build a party of unlikely allies, and survive tactical card battles as Fyodor searches for a cure for his dying tribe.

4588010.title: PROJECT: OJISAN
4588010.short_description: 这是一款把中年大叔叠起来的游戏。在你想放空大脑的时候玩一玩吧。

4925840.title: Bull&Bear Crypto Trading Simulator Demo
4925840.short_description: Turn $1,000 into a crypto empire: 34 coins, up to 100x leverage, real liquidations. Unlock the options desk, spoof the order book with fake $10M walls, move markets as the whale — then run your own fund. Survive exchange hacks, stablecoin depegs and cascading crashes 📈

4599400.title: Darklords: Siegefront
4599400.short_description: Pick Human or Demon in a real-time strategy game with twelve units and faction skills per race, custom six-unit armies, and a multi-difficulty campaign. Finish the campaign to unlock Challenge Mode and top your records.

4804250.title: 夜袭者
4804250.short_description: 在无尽的黑暗浪潮中，你孤身一人。在这款 3D 俯视角 Roguelike 生存射击游戏中，挥舞辉光之剑、释放毁灭魔法，在成群的怪物包 围中杀出一条血路。自动瞄准，专注走位，从 20 余种强化技能中构建你的终极 Build——你能存活多久？

4775010.title: Bullet Rift Demo
4775010.short_description: Bullet Rift is a top-down shooter ARPG packed with loot, builds, dungeons, rifts, crafting, bosses, and deep character progression. Blast through hordes, chase legendary gear, perfect your build, and push deeper into an endgame built for players who love grinding for power.

4787300.title: Zerion: Infinite Space
4787300.short_description: Free-to-play space MMO. Pilot a starship across an infinite procedural galaxy — explore 15 civilizations, claim sectors, fight in fleets, trade on the player marketplace.

4917950.title: Starlit World Demo
4917950.short_description: The heart of the universe is shattered! Join Bo and Kikki to rescue Starlits across mysterious worlds. Master 20 suits to explore and fight. Rebuild your home in this cozy adventure. Save the universe with heart!

4774490.title: Pay Off The Mortgage
4774490.short_description: Pay Off The Mortgage is a cozy clicker where every dollar matters. Work, get promoted, survive the bank’s endless taunts and hunger for your money, and chase the impossible dream of owning your home. But whatever happens… Please take care of Greg, he keeps the house warm.

4508570.title: 真理谭：黑暗城堡的女巫
4508570.short_description: 打开这本书的那一刻，你就不再只是"读者"——这是一款在书页中冒险的"阅读式"奇幻RPG。曾在香草社（Vanillaware）任职、深耕游戏业界30余年的工匠，倾注6年时光亲手打造，100%纯手工的一册。

4781720.title: 该死的谐音梗
4781720.short_description: 两张图，一个答案。猜不出来抓耳挠腮，猜出来只想喊一句：这也行？《该死的谐音梗》是一款爆笑又上头的看图猜答案游戏。根据提示图片大开脑洞，从谐音、双关和语言梗中找到那些“明明很荒唐，但好像又说得通”的答案，收获一条新鲜烂梗，让你的日常多一点离谱的快乐。

4521970.title: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale｜Chapter 0+1 Demo
4521970.short_description: ✦《求择选：伊万篇》是一款选择取向探索式视觉小说。 故事主要讲述一只名为“伊万·维克托罗维奇·贝理亚叶夫”斯拉夫小白鼠在美国的VR回忆影像。

4928570.title: Pis-to-le-ro Demo
4928570.short_description: PIS-TO-LE-RO es un juego multijugador local de estrategia por casillas que te transporta a un salvaje oeste lleno de bandidos y vaqueros. ¡Sigue el ritmo de la música mientras te enfrentas al contrario para poder acabar con él antes de que lo haga contigo!

4927970.title: Slime Locomotion Demo
4927970.short_description: 基于惯性传感器的自然移动方案。通过捕捉人体姿态，实现前后左右4个方向移动。

4833680.title: BULLACATOR -pusher tank battle-
4833680.short_description: BULLACATOR fuses coin pusher mechanics with roguelite deck-building. Combine uniquely skilled bullets and shields to forge your deck and slay the mysterious Shadows.

4888370.title: Violet Requiem Demo
4888370.short_description: She never meant to love a monster. She only meant to find her truth. Play the demo for Violet Requiem, an otome visual novel with spicy 18+ illustrated cryptid romance, paranormal investigations, and 5 supernatural love interests to sink your teeth into.

4834080.title: Make it! Shaved Ice
4834080.short_description: Get ready for a delicious shaved ice challenge! Make lots of shaved ice and watch your food cart prosper!

4581510.title: Safe Haven Repair Station
4581510.short_description: Make a new start in a dying city. Repair arcane cyberpunk items, befriend odd and intriguing characters, and make choices to shape the world around you, all from the warmth of your workbench.

4866530.title: Swarmslam Demo
4866530.short_description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

4875720.title: shark
4875720.short_description: Shark is a fast-paced reflex game about racing the clock to reach the flag in randomly generated levels. Dash through obstacles, chain through arrows, and don't let "impossible" levels fool you. This is an endless game of speed. How fast can you swim?

4078750.title: Pets party Demo
4078750.short_description: 🐾 选择你的宠物，自定义外观，与朋友一起参加疯狂竞速和混乱战斗。使用道具、武器和各种意想不到的技巧赢得胜利。一款支持 8+ 玩家在线或本地游玩的多人派对游戏！

3916610.title: Caterpillar King
3916610.short_description: Protect a hungry Caterpillar and guide him home in this turn-based puzzle strategy game about friendship, responsibility, and finding a family.

4129340.title: DEMO - Lumiric Stage
4129340.short_description: Create musical content with real-time MIDI visualization, Magic Piano, Floating Labels, built-in camera support, and cinematic Stages. Designed for creators, pianists, educators, and streamers.

4540610.title: Labyrinth of Whiskers
4540610.short_description: In this game maps become larger and harder to get through, there are 3 ending portions of each map which only 1 will randomly have the final cheese to leave and unlock the next level, you will collect cheese throughout the maze to purchase more mazes to conquer.

4927390.title: Darning Demo
4927390.short_description: A cozy game about quietly putting the world back together. Stitch torn, faded cloth and watch hidden color bloom beneath your needle — every piece a small surprise, endlessly new, and yours to keep. No timers. No scores. No failing. Just you, a thread, and the calm of mending.

4912920.title: Read of Mask Demo
4912920.short_description: Get a taste of Read of Mask! This demo includes 5 distinct rooms designed to introduce our core puzzle mechanics and atmosphere. Jump in and leave us your feedback!

4260190.title: Mine of my Mind
4260190.short_description: This is a horror where you play as a miner experiencing a midlife crisis. The final shift before a long-awaited promotion goes wrong: reality begins to warp, turning a workday into a nightmare. Will he be able to escape the depths of his own mind?

4637560.title: BleepWare Incrementals
4637560.short_description: Five complete incremental games, plus a crossover that ties them together. Command a growing war machine, dig ever deeper for resources, survive escalating defense battles, embrace chaotic absurdity, and fish through creeping darkness in one strange collection of number-goes-up adventures.

4773260.title: Bardo
4773260.short_description: 这就是大话骰，直到输的人重写规则。和最多6位真人玩家在线斗智，或者和一群有自己脑子的AI老千周旋，再撑过那些天马行空的事件回合：藏手牌、亮全部、只押一个点数。酒馆够暖，心眼够狠。

4576570.title: Somnus Corporation
4576570.short_description: 一款设定在即将崩塌的梦境模拟世界中的心理异常检测恐怖游戏。报告异常之处。质疑现实。决定意识的价值。

4330950.title: Heatspire
4330950.short_description: Build devastating chains in this satisfying Connect-Four roguelike. Battle drunk ogres and loud knights, stack run-defining charms, drink powerful brews, and push your luck for explosive combos.

4457130.title: The Adventures Of Hooman
4457130.short_description: A sci-fi comedy graphic novel where you play Hooman, an android too conceited to be scared and too lucky to die. Your crew is going to die but they could have avoided an untimely death if they had only listened to you. You are not the problem.

4924730.title: Heroes And Zombies Demo
4924730.short_description: Heroes and Zombies is a high-octane twin-stick shooter where you fight to survive against endless hordes of the undead. Choose your unique hero, collect devastating weapons, and use your reflexes to hold off waves of enemies in this fast-paced action experience.

4787550.title: Milichess
4787550.short_description: A toy-table tactical strategy game where commanders move soldiers, tanks, engineers, radar, SAM sites, and aircraft across fogged battlefields. Outmaneuver your opponent through positioning, terrain, supply pressure, and air missions in MiliChess, Req. Ammo, or classic Chess modes.

4767420.title: Forest Lookout
4767420.short_description: Forest Lookout is a first-person horror game where you navigate a lost person in a forest to safety. You can choose beetween options in dialogs to them. Listen to them, keep track of them, use your map and lead them out of the woods.

4717660.title: Neo-Node
4717660.short_description: Build charged 2x2 Neo-Nodes, trigger explosive chain reactions, and chase the global leaderboard in a fast neon arcade puzzle game where one perfect move can save the run.

4760110.title: Sauve le Shérif !
4760110.short_description: Sauve le Shérif 4 à 10 joueurs. Deux saloons. Une seule règle : ne fais confiance à personne. Chat vocal en proximité, duels en face-à-face, et un dilemme à chaque tir : pacifier ou abattre.

4926320.title: PSYCHE Demo
4926320.short_description: A fast paced, difficult, surreal 2nd person arena shooter with secrets, unlockables, backflips and leaderboards.

4104650.title: Mechanis Obscura Demo
4104650.short_description: MECHANIS OBSCURA is an indie psychological escape-room thriller game, blending FMV cutscenes, 2000s horror vibes, and intricate puzzle mechanisms. After unknowingly enrolling in a deep-web trial, you have been abducted into a nightmarish escape room. No choices, only one reality remains...ESCAPE!

4766440.title: 多眼症 Polyopthalmia Demo
4766440.short_description: 一款俯视角竞技场射击游戏，你需要击破你看到的每个眼球，在充满凝视的竞技场中生存下来，获取高分

4848170.title: Vigilum
4848170.short_description: A first-person survival horror with roguelike influences. Prepare during the day by brewing potions, crafting sigil materials and gathering resources. Survive through the night, where Dr. Hayden will trace your steps, react to your actions and adapt his strategy to hunt you down.

4601840.title: Tales from the Other Side: Beneath the Roots
4601840.short_description: Psychological first-person horror. Fate brings you to your grandfather’s house, left abandoned after his mysterious disappearance. Explore it and uncover the dark secret hidden within.

4918410.title: Vampolitics: Vassal of the Void Demo
4918410.short_description: Rule a vampire coven from your throne in deep space. Judge petitioners, manage blood and gold, and face a war you didn't choose. Reign well, or reign briefly.

4093240.title: 东京女武神
4093240.short_description: 那副卡组，将成为拯救东京的王牌！本作是一款卡组构筑型的轻度Rogue游戏，玩家通过不断调整卡组、拟定战略、击败挡在前方的敌人，逐步推进地图。构筑你的卡组，守护东京，抵御里世界的侵袭！

4896840.title: ORU IN THE VOID Demo
4896840.short_description: 这是一款充满氛围感的平台游戏，讲述关于孤独、回忆与内心挣扎的深刻故事。引导奥鲁穿越神秘的虚空，在一段充满象征意义与希望的旅程中克服精准的平台挑战。

4798350.title: European Seafreight Tycoon
4798350.short_description: Build your own maritime freight company, plan trade routes between European ports, and manage ships, crews, and operating costs. Transport containers and specialized cargo, optimize your fleet, and grow your business into one of Europe's leading logistics networks.

4917790.title: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld Demo
4917790.short_description: 关于埃及黑社会中的阿努比斯的动作RPG俯视图：快速近距离战斗，抽搐，遗物和与成群的死者和古代神灵的战斗。

3957810.title: Beghost
3957810.short_description: BEGHOST is a narrative-heavy 2D action-adventure game set in the bowels of a haunted dungeon. Uncover the dungeon's darkest secrets with your ghost girl companion Bee, as you navigate your way through enemies, traps, and more, in a desperate attempt to escape!

4856990.title: Plantify
4856990.short_description: Plantify is a third-person farming game which focuses on a small cat learning how to properly take care of plants.

4861010.title: RollRift Arena
4861010.short_description: 在不断坍塌的格子竞技场中，用骰子点数争夺每回合的控制权！移动、攻击、抢占厨房与浴室里的强力道具，在地图一圈圈崩塌中活到最后。支持在线 PVP 实时匹配、真人机对战与本地双人同屏，附带全球排行榜和角色像素自定义。一局几分钟，上手简单，博弈很深。

4856860.title: 净化战线（异净特遣队） DEMO
4856860.short_description: 《净化战线 Demo》将开放游戏核心玩法内容，带来一段可实际游玩的爬塔肉鸽战斗体验。在本次 Demo 中，玩家可以提前体验以高塔推进为核心的关卡流程，挑战包含战斗、事件与强化选择在内的随机节点路线，感受每一局都不同的成长与构筑节奏。你将操作多名风格各异的干员组成小队，在高速闪避、瞄准射击与角色切换中应对不断增强的敌人与弹幕压力，体验《净化战线》结合动作操作与路线策略的核心战斗乐趣。通过本次 Demo，你可以提前了解游戏的基础战斗系统、爬塔推进结构以及肉鸽构筑玩法，感受正式版所呈现的废土高压战斗氛围。

4851300.title: Pocket Pond
4851300.short_description: A tiny angler who fishes on your desktop while you work. Pocket Pond is a cozy idle overlay where a pixel-art fisherman auto-casts, reels in 130 species, and fills your codex - no clicking required. Just let him drift in the corner of your screen and see what's biting.

4656420.title: Ars Et Anima
4656420.short_description: A relaxing educational experience set in the Renaissance: face ancient Latin quizzes inside the convent of today's San Marco Museum in Florence. Test your knowledge and help Beato Angelico complete a precious painting commissioned by Cosimo de' Medici.

4870090.title: Noodle Cable Demo
4870090.short_description: The Noodle Cable Technologies welcome you in their company. Untangle and plug huge cables in room-sized puzzles and witness mind-altering surrealist environments.

4860070.title: CluDoku
4860070.short_description: A murder mystery blended with sudoku-style logic. Explore suspicious rooms, examine weapon evidence, and piece together clues through sharp deduction to reveal the killer. Play alone or work online with up to 4 detectives to solve the case together.

4045460.title: Ezalm: Magic's Memory Demo
4045460.short_description: A narrative-driven action RPG where your combat style depends on the elemental magic you choose. Lost in a forgotten region, unravel the mysteries of ancient peoples to find your way back to Ezalm.

3863770.title: 水管公司
3863770.short_description: 一款融合拼接解谜、资源经营与肉鸽元素的水管工模拟游戏。接受越来越复杂的维修订单，在狭窄空间中连接管道，合理管理有限的工具与材料，通过策略规划与巧妙施工寻找最高效率的解决方案。

4856470.title: SOFIE SCOUT and the Road to Poland
4856470.short_description: Run fast, jump high and support a great cause! Guide Sofie across Europe to reach the World Scout Jamboree in Poland. All profits help real scouts attend the event!

4924250.title: Pixel: The Challenge Demo
4924250.short_description: A 3D puzzle game in the spirit of the great tile-based logic classics. Collect every Pixel, find the keys, master ice, fire, conveyor belts and monsters — and reach the Plenum. 80 hand-crafted levels, every one provably solvable. Two art styles, three cameras.

4904960.title: Shattered Worlds Demo
4904960.short_description: A fantasy turn-based strategy game where worlds get torn apart

4904820.title: Rever4 Demo
4904820.short_description: 最多4人游玩的全新黑白棋。Rever4 支持单人游玩、本地对战、局域网对战和在线对战，并收录经典黑白棋、3-Way、4-Way、Duo、Quartet 等多种规则。

4798820.title: 虚无之塔
4798820.short_description: 《虚无之塔》 是一款战术 Roguelike RPG。布阵策略 + 自动战斗 + 装备刷取 + 职业养成，核心乐趣在于针对不同敌人搭配阵容、站位、技能和装备。

3041280.title: 谎言之牢
3041280.short_description: 这是一部短篇视觉小说。四名死囚犯都被撤销了所有指控，但监狱有一项“指标”需要达成。于是，她们被关在一起，被迫在一小时内作出决定……要被处死的是谁？

4791950.title: ScramBrawl Demo
4791950.short_description: Fight your friends as clumsy, half-boiled eggs in this physics-based party brawler for 1-4 players. Fire your yolk or grab whatever you can to knock out your enemies across hazardous arenas. Scramble your way to victory in hilarious, chaotic brawls!

4773850.title: 剩余价值模拟器
4773850.short_description: 本游戏尝试对资本主义社会进行一次简化的抽象演绎，通过模拟剩余价值、商品、债权、股权、地权等要素在市场中的交易、流通与转化来实现这一目标。每种经济单位都具备独特的经济行为，并通过市场交易参与全局经济活动；每个单位都拥有独立的资产面板，每笔交易都会实时改变其资产状况。

4855490.title: clear cherry ice.
4855490.short_description: Did I really save this pretty boy ten years ago...? A fresh summer youth BL visual novel about memory, promises, and mutual salvation. [clear cherry ice.] Get closer to Jiwon and Chaehyun, and see whether your bond becomes friendship—or something more.

4827360.title: JAM Adventures Demo
4827360.short_description: JamAdventure is a musical odyssey where your real-life instrument is the controller. Explore 10 vibrant themed realms to discover and master unique songs, or import your own library to jam along to your favorite tracks. Tuned for 6-string guitar and 4-string bass, but supports nearly any instrument.

4890640.title: Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey Demo
4890640.short_description: 《暮光之潮 :幻蓝秩元恋》是一款塔罗牌驱动的命运恋爱抉择游戏，22 张奇幻塔罗串联全作。黑洞破碎世界、残酷末世下依然有美丽外表的乌托邦，善于摸鱼的女人公——泉水芙蓉，周围时间记忆持续消失。意外发现一套掌控人类注意力古老时间系统。与3位主世界时空男主发生了一系列故事。波塞冬·幻蓝「 深蓝合众国 」、科技之国阿波罗·白墨「 天穹联邦 」以及哈迪斯·夜尘主导「 冥河帝国 」。背后隐藏着惊人秘密。遭遇高阶文明最高维度生命时间掠夺。 主世界时空之外，被时间系统投入乱世逃生时空副本，双世界并行。副本遭遇残酷真实二战南洋战乱背景。数十万人殒命。副本平行时空不同逃生路线相遇不同男主。命运齿轮被强行推动。

4345460.title: Unpaired Socks
4345460.short_description: A relaxing pixel art game about matching socks. Figure out the matches to help 10 villagers sort through their messy piles of socks. Or just enjoy endlessly pairing for creating your own sock collection.

4851600.title: plink
4851600.short_description: One drop. Zero room for error. Can you master the physics of the bounce?

4799480.title: Bright Light Demo
4799480.short_description: Fantasy blast in the style of retro boomer shooters — an action-packed pixel carnage where hordes of monsters, dark magic, and devious trolls await. Relive the golden age of classic shooters with fast-paced gameplay, a brutal arsenal, and relentless enemies. Don’t forget to save the princess!

4733540.title: Dome: Become Thyself
4733540.short_description: Dome: Become Thyself is an action adventure roguelite RPG set in the infinite world of Akashic Records. Learn and master the language of emotions, weave sentences, and manifest reality. Explore infinite rooms and biomes, speak to other versions of yourself, and uncover the hidden rules of reality.

4899790.title: Neuro Hunter
4899790.short_description: Dark, Corrupt, buried deep in Secrets and Lies. Your prospects were low until the Corporation gave you an offer. A job too easy, too good to be true... it was!

4868140.title: 差值风暴
4868140.short_description: 一款原创“甩牌”卡牌游戏，核心只有一个机制：你压过的每张牌，罚摸＝差值×牌型倍率。在 2–4 人经典对局与 17 场规则颠覆的 Boss 肉鸽冒险中抢先出完手牌。可单机对战 AI，也可与好友联机。永不 pay-to-win。

2377930.title: 造化仙缘
2377930.short_description: 《造化仙缘》是一款修仙题材的角色扮演游戏，本作最大魅力在于多路线剧情选择分支与高密度爽点的爽文式剧情。传说在宇宙开辟之初，诞生了几件造化至宝，各自拥有逆天的功能。你无意中获得其中一件造化至宝，开始了如同开挂一般的修仙之旅。

4719680.title: World Tree Defender - Seedlings of Yggdrasil Demo
4719680.short_description: A roguelite hex-grid tower defense. Defend the World Tree, hunt soul relics, push deeper into corruption — every run makes the next one harder, and your build stronger.

4483200.title: 柯基生存者
4483200.short_description: 高速生存 Doglite 游戏！在蜂拥而至的昆虫与野生动物袭击中活到最后！简单操作与高速节奏结合的 Doglite 生存体验！

4140190.title: Dice Rogues
4140190.short_description: Dice Rogues is a tactical roguelite with infinite possibilities where you upgrade your dice and harness unpredictable rogue faces (X2, baguette, croissant, etc.) to bend fate, outplay the House, and survive a new roll each run.

4806800.title: A Game About Leading A Crowds
4806800.short_description: A Short , Simple and Satisfying Incremental Game About Leading Your Crowds to Defend the castle. Lead , Fight back , And Upgrades Yourself to Overpower.

4866810.title: Mora's Cat Scratcher PLUS
4866810.short_description: Meet Mora — a confident little black cat with a crown and a paw that won't stay still. Scratch, dig, and uncover sparkling treasures in a cozy tap-and-collect game built for relaxed play. Unlock outfits, crowns, and PLUS-exclusive content in Mora's Steam debut.

4825510.title: Skulls Skulls Skulls by Daniel da Silva
4825510.short_description: Skulls Skulls Skulls is a short active Incremental game. Fire spells at the cave, get skulls, spend skulls on yourself and get more and more powerful!

1511740.title: ALEK
1511740.short_description: Post-soviet Russia, Tyumen in 1995. Alexey Smirnov, a local shot-caller, nicknamed 'Alek' found out about the death of his friends and swore to avenge. The bloody war started between the gangs of the city. However, a true enemy turned out not to be common gangsters, but men much scarier

4927810.title: Sacred Echoes Demo
4927810.short_description: Sacred Echoes is a story-driven souls-like action adventure. Play as The Shattered One and fight alongside your gang of swordsmen and gunslingers across floating islands to confront the man who shattered the Crystal Bound Island. Experience the exclusive prologue section in the demo!

3692680.title: EGO
3692680.short_description: 一款以烟雾为主题的3D横版过关游戏。在这款街机风格的《烟雾巫师》游戏中，你将在开放式的关卡中一次性与成千上万的机器人战斗！冲刺、跳跃、攀爬，点燃你的烟雾，消灭所有挡在你面前的机器人！

4840910.title: Kill The Sea Demo
4840910.short_description: 在这款航海沙盒类幸存者游戏中，开启横跨七海的致命征程。狩猎传说中的猛兽、完成交付、赢得竞赛并寻找宝藏。在这个充满混沌、风险与机遇的海洋世界中，扬帆驶向胜利。

4825850.title: Breath of Digital God Demo
4825850.short_description: Become a digital god in a fast-paced meditave bullet hell. Freeze time, reverse reality, and survive waves of chaotic energy synced to music. Master your abilities and reach the highest level of reality.

4932380.title: Keaton Carver's Knife Solutions Demo
4932380.short_description: A physics based puzzle rage game about solving peoples' problems with a knife.

4849860.title: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween Demo
4849860.short_description: Oh no! It’s Halloween and Toey Weedz' best friend—the famous rapping cow—has been kidnapped! Save Fatcow in this retro FPS demo. Blast through a spooky meadow, ride a motorcycle, and face a cow-tastic boss! Pure stoner-trash horror built on solid shooter gameplay.

4068360.title: Bottom Squad
4068360.short_description: 一个显示在屏幕底部的放置防御游戏。组建你的队伍，升级你的基地，同时阻止源源不断的外星人攻击，即使你在工作或浏览网页。

3630480.title: RuneKingdom
3630480.short_description: Explore a hand-crafted 2D world of adventure in RuneKingdom. Master 16 unique skills, battle 150+ fierce foes, craft legendary gear, and shape your legacy. Your epic journey awaits!

4032350.title: EA SPORTS™ College Football 27
4032350.short_description: 踏入大学橄榄球的现代时代，在个人抱负与校队荣誉的交汇中展开征程。在沉浸于比赛日传统与盛典氛围的同时，平衡各方期望、自身特质以及周六赛事所要求的一切。

3227320.title: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey
3227320.short_description: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG. Wield magic and might against legendary foes from Greek mythology. Recruit a synergistic army and cultivate your hero to win Immortal Glory!

4534300.title: Weird Water World
4534300.short_description: Fish dark waters and discover procedurally generated fish that come in every color of the rainbow. Explore a weird ocean world haunted by Thalassophobic titans. Sell your catches. Try your luck sports betting at the bar. Drink delicious juices. Get eaten alive. Appease the Gods. Find your way home.

4665930.title: KUBB Demo
4665930.short_description: 《Kubb》免费试玩版——一款每个方块都在讲故事的 Roguelike 堆叠游戏。用 35 个初始方块构筑卡组、挺过灾难、踏入维度。完整版再解锁 30+ 个。易于上手，难以精通。再来一局?

4713470.title: The Red Weight Demo
4713470.short_description: Mars, Bab al-Hadid habitat. A body in a corridor. A cover-up nobody asked you to crack. Under a sky that will kill you in three minutes, how much weight will you carry for another?

4870310.title: Garden Defence Demo
4870310.short_description: Defend your garden from a bug invasion using everyday objects turned into turrets: magnifying glasses, garden hoses, UV lamps, and more. Upgrade your defenses, adapt to changing weather, and outsmart increasingly cunning enemies in this strategic tower defense with a backyard twist.

4373160.title: 邪祟
4373160.short_description: 在幽深山林间，有一座香火凋零的狐仙庙。作为一名初来乍到的出马仙，靠着能与仙家沟通的神力，你成为了这里的新任守护者。然而，这座寺庙远非净土，污秽之物横行，邪祟在黑暗中窥伺。你能否在这片被诅咒的土地上，熬过每一个夜晚？

4720870.title: Backrooms: Fade
4720870.short_description: Backrooms: Fade is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Alone or with friends, you will explore a nightmarish level, trying to understand where you are, what is happening, and how to survive.

3265230.title: Cursed Companions
3265230.short_description: 多人在线语音操控恐怖游戏——小心你的嘴！每个人都有一个禁忌词，说出口就会伤害朋友。探索阴森地牢，用说话施法打怪。又搞笑又恐怖，还要提防朋友背后捅刀

4596160.title: Gray Trading
4596160.short_description: Gray Trading是一款放置类游戏，您可以买卖股票、交易外汇，并深入探索其他不寻常的市场。赚取金钱、解锁升级，征服每一种交易类型。

4436830.title: Market Moe Prologue
4436830.short_description: Work the night shift on a Japanese street… where something shouldn’t be there.

4889230.title: To Type a Tale Demo
4889230.short_description: To Type a Tale is a fantasy choose-your-own-adventure story where the only method of interaction is typing. Story progress, choices, and menus are all achieved through typing highlighted words.

4849630.title: Vape Store Miami: Prologue
4849630.short_description: Get your first taste of running a retro Miami vape shop in this 1–4 player co-op simulator prologue. Stock shelves, serve customers, craft custom e-liquids, handle phone and online orders, build your reputation, and lay the foundation for a growing business.

4790520.title: 电梯: 无间
4790520.short_description: 「电梯: 无间」是一款第一人称视角的港风复古心理恐怖游戏。你被困在了一栋阴暗老旧的公寓电梯之中，在近乎窒息的幽闭空间里，唯一的对外联系只有紧急通话按钮中、那个自称是“维修工”的陌生声音。面对不断上演的诡异异象，你该盲从他的指令，还是在黑暗中自寻生路？

4897740.title: Malice in Wonderland Demo
4897740.short_description: Tear through Wonderland and break free of The Hatter's control in this fast-paced action roguelike. Augment your abilities to destroy your foes and escape before you're out of time!

1349930.title: Cyber Psychosis
1349930.short_description: Cyber Psychosis is a pseudo-3D dynamic first-person shooter in a cyberpunk setting with a lot of enemies, blood and drive

4329100.title: Our Wonderland
4329100.short_description: A horror-fantasy visual novel following the trials of a dysfunctional friend group thrust back into the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. Either they face the issues plaguing them or risk dying in horrific ways again… and again… and again.

4809010.title: Cozy Tide
4809010.short_description: A cozy fishing and island-building game where you catch strange fish, expand your tiny island, decorate postcard islands, complete daily voyages, and collect your way through a cheerful ocean world.

4820270.title: Prince of Vibe Code
4820270.short_description: An incremental game where you become the most successful game developer. Create and play 44 games with just a few clicks, read the chat and follow the story, sell your games, and grow your fanbase. You win when you have $1,000,000,000,000 and 7 billion followers.

4867060.title: Idle Hands
4867060.short_description: Summon demons, descend the nine Circles of Hell, and gamble your soul with the Devil. A wicked idle clicker... multiply your power with every descent, tempt fate at the Crossroads, and battle Satan in a duel that never plays out the same way twice.

3534790.title: Mesmalie
3534790.short_description: MESMALIE is an occult visual novel with point and click mechanics. A magickal incident in your personal life brings you to a small witches' coven in the middle of nowhere. Here, you'll learn to tame your ability... though, not without some bumps along the way.

4806090.title: SonderSoft Soccer: Monkeys VS Robots!
4806090.short_description: We forced a bunch of monkeys to compete against robots for half a year in 20 virtual soccer fields, and now YOU can enjoy the resulting shenanigans. Machine learning is the future, and the future is Monkeys VS Robots, where you go head to head with Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning (GAIL!!!)

4867550.title: Dark Hollow RPG
4867550.short_description: Descend into an ever-changing dungeon, battle monsters, unlock dozens of achievements, and shape your legend in a fully text-based RPG inspired by classic terminal adventures.

4900730.title: Fabled Kingdoms Demo
4900730.short_description: Play the opening Stormguard campaign and skirmish battles in this demo of a turn-based fantasy strategy game featuring tactical grid-based combat and unique factions.

4887320.title: 中式煎饼模拟器
4887320.short_description: 从一处不起眼的小摊开始，采购食材、制作煎饼、服务顾客、升级设备，在日复一日的经营中将煎饼生意发展壮大。

4668040.title: Capybara Bingo
4668040.short_description: 适合1至8名玩家的温馨派对宾果游戏。最多管理6张卡片，标记你的数字，抢先喊出宾果——但喊错了你就要付出代价。与卡皮巴拉、技能和大量装扮共享温馨的混乱。

4175650.title: FLESHBREAK
4175650.short_description: A story-driven survival visual novel inspired by SCP-610. Face a flesh-spreading outbreak, make brutal moral choices, protect the people you can’t let go of, and uncover the terrifying truth behind the disease.

4825940.title: Negative Edge Demo
4825940.short_description: Annihilate alien hordes and push your combat to the limit in this action-packed Negative Edge DEMO. Experience hybrid combat, grappling hook-based mobility, brutal finishers, and your first encounter with Argus, a biomechanical behemoth.

4793460.title: Disgaea Mayhem Demo
4793460.short_description: Magichange into action with this brand new take on the Disgaea franchise! It's time to fight your own battles with responsive, action-packed combat.

4809670.title: 玄戒修仙路：桃花天命
4809670.short_description: 一枚玄戒打开须弥界，也打开了你的修仙日程：刷怪、捡宝、配装备、闯秘境、渡突破。用功法、武学与法宝养出自己的构筑，结识天命同伴，在桃花与深渊之间慢慢修出一条路。

4834000.title: Deadlined.
4834000.short_description: a Psychological Horror where you lose yourself while trying to finish your paperwork before the Deadline.

4815620.title: Tattoo Dungeon
4815620.short_description: Tattoo Dungeon is an action-adventure style platformer, where you play as a tattoo apprentice who gets thrown into the midst of an invasion of other-dimensional tattoo monsters, all while trying to find your mentor's lost tattoo flash!

4809360.title: Core Override
4809360.short_description: 收集模块，打造最强 Build。 Core Override 是一款弹幕射击游戏。击败敌人，收集模块，在突破无尽弹幕的同时打造属于自己的独特 Build。 自由组合各种模块，完善你的战斗策略，挑战更加强大的敌人。

4906550.title: 终点站 Demo
4906550.short_description: 在一次战争结束后，我们被遗弃在故事的尽头，寒冷的冬天，间歇性过境的台风，与时不时产生的地震波 ，一切的灾难似乎都想抹除“我们”的存在，但这里不应该是“我们”的终点，视觉小说『终点站』将讲述一个来自战后的故事

4380490.title: 猫咪邮政
4380490.short_description: 和好友一起变成猫猫，把邮局做大做强！我是一只猫，一夜之间继承了整个邮局...包裹如潮水般涌来！打包、分类、配送，把猫岛村民的心意寄往远方。把凌乱货架变得整整齐齐，享受治愈的慢时光。夜晚还会有神秘的魔法包裹悄然出现...总之，神奇的猫咪邮政，为您服务！

4893830.title: Cleaning Angel Wired Demo
4893830.short_description: 一款俯视角幸存者动作游戏。使用自动攻击击退不断涌来的敌群，并通过组合武器与属性反应成长。操作简单易上手，叠加火、冰、雷等属性，用属于自己的构筑挑战敌群。

4530260.title: Now
4530260.short_description: Now is a challenging horror-strategy FPS survival game. Set in a dark world filled with radiation and mystery, you must complete various missions while trying to stay alive against terrifying threats. Do you have the skills and courage to survive in the middle of this darkness? Let's see!

4912550.title: 星轨 Star Curve Demo
4912550.short_description: 《星轨 Star Curve》是一款单人逻辑推理游戏。你将在三墩镇一座破旧的天文台中展开探索，一边修复沉寂已久的观星设施，一边揭开隐藏在小镇历史中的秘密。借助自由的笔记系统，观察墙面上由宝石构成的谜题，推测它们背后的规则，并按照自己的节奏解开一系列精心设计的逻辑谜题。

4864450.title: ΠΟΛΙΣ — Athens
4864450.short_description: 执掌古典雅典，走过前594至前322共 272 年完整历史。在332 个史实事件中权衡家族派系、神明眷顾与同盟离合——而历史的洪流，终将把你的城邦不可逆地带向前322。

4930230.title: Soul Stone Defense Demo
4930230.short_description: A dark fantasy tower defense and survival game where you build defenses by day and possess your warriors by night to fight off endless waves of monsters.

4877230.title: Miaugical Demo
4877230.short_description: Change the world with your magic in Miaugical!, an epic adventure where mysteries abound. Explore the world, uncover secrets, discover your power in an isometric 3D Adventure-RPG style, and face great challenges in a 2D Rogue-Lite, surrounded by cute kittens and not-so-cute enemies.

4862400.title: Sim: World Cup Manager
4862400.short_description: Take charge of your nation from a world of 202 teams and chase international glory. Build your squad, master deep tactics and live sideline shouts, unearth wonderkids in your national youth academy, and battle through the World Cup and Continental Championships in a deep football management sim.

4594240.title: Tattered Banners Demo
4594240.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a fantasy realm where the land itself changes. This demo showcases core mechanics that will be expanded in the full version of the game.

3751950.title: 刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置
3751950.short_description: 经典单人海盗冒险之旅现已回归。在这部忠实还原且经过优化的重制版中，你将扮演爱德华·肯威，在海盗的黄金时代扬帆加勒比海。本作拥有惊艳的视觉效果、经过升级的玩法以及全新的内容。

3897960.title: Wahm
3897960.short_description: A psychological Arabic horror short story. You set off toward the Empty Quarter, off-roading deep into the vast desert, a place meant for peace and clarity.

4556460.title: Social Lab Demo
4556460.short_description: AI 会朝天开枪并选择合作，还是会向你开枪并背叛你？ Social Lab 是一款同时行动的回合制策略游戏，你必须在合作与背叛之间做出最佳选择。

4879230.title: CURSOR SLASH Demo
4879230.short_description: 一款用鼠标光标自动攻击的像素风成长动作游戏！魔法弹、陨石、火焰区域、激光等技能会自动发动。强化技能与武器，获得遗物和金币，横扫无数史莱姆吧！

4048500.title: Chthonian TD
4048500.short_description: Fast-paced co-op action roguelite × tower defense. Fight escalating waves, risk resources in a dangerous mine, defeat the boss - then see how long you survive in Endless.

4856460.title: 记忆收藏家 · The Memory Mender
