4856460.short_description: 在拾光馆——现实与遗忘之间的旧宅——你是一位收藏家。帮来访者潜入记忆深处，修复那些破碎的瞬间，学会好好告别。四季轮转，数十位来访者，五幕主线，多个结局。修复本身，就是治愈。

4634940.title: Architect of War
4634940.short_description: A strategic tower defense with roguelike elements where every enemy demands an answer. Prepare your team, adapt your defense, and face waves designed to break your strategy.

3620130.title: 披萨哎哟！
3620130.short_description: Grab 3 friends and deliver a pizza worth a million-dollar tip. Keep it hot, keep it safe, and blame your crew when everything goes wrong.

4589040.title: HouseWarming
4589040.short_description: Brian Lewis 买下一栋老房子，希望开始安静而有秩序的生活。但在第一个夜晚，房子就开始变得诡异……原本看似无害的意外，逐渐变成更加可怕的事情……如果屋里还有别人呢？

4365920.title: Buccaneer's Booty
4365920.short_description: 在这款可爱的类推箱子游戏中，你的目标是运用逻辑、位置布局和一点海盗的巧思，埋藏每个岛屿上的所有宝藏。穿越40座天堂般的岛屿，你将发射大炮，并推动、摧毁、沉没、掩埋物品，解开越来越巧妙的谜题。

4919300.title: Cyberwars Demo
4919300.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelike where you run a mercenary company. Draft and deploy a deck of soldiers and vehicles, hire new mercenaries in the field, take territory against an AI opponent or your friends on hand-built maps, and clear contracts before the week timer ticks to zero and the run ends.

3935020.title: Backyard Baseball
3935020.short_description: The arcade-style classic is back - and it's leveling up. With enhanced gameplay, new game modes, and all the humor & charm of the original, this is Backyard Baseball like it was always meant to be played. Wishlist now for Opening Day on July 9th. Are you ready to play like a kid again?

4548160.title: Don't Chicken Out
4548160.short_description: 一款极其困难的游戏，两只小鸡需要一起平衡一颗鸡蛋。你能坚持通关，还是会中途放弃？独自或与好友在线合作，一起受苦并走向胜利！

4540330.title: Re:Born Isekai Company
4540330.short_description: "异世界转生？一切尽在你的掌握之中。" 在《异世界转生中介所》审查无数灵魂，并将他们派遣至合适的异世界。在这款文字驱动的审查模拟游戏中，你在文件里挑出的漏洞、或是提出的某一个问题，都可能造就一位传奇勇者，或是降下一场灭顶之灾。

4854210.title: In Tenebris Demo
4854210.short_description: In Tenebris is a dark, first-person sci-fi horror game where echolocation is the only way to find your way out. You see while you make sound, but you can also be heard by those you don't want to be around. Explore the corridors of a research facility, avoid enemies, and try to survive.

4604330.title: CYBER92 DATAWAR
4604330.short_description: CYBER92 DATAWAR is a Surreal, Retro-Realistic Cyberpunk Shooter, First time 3rd/2nd-Person perspective. 90's Pixel-Glitch Art style. Shift through glitching vision modes, use destructive vehicles, and survive a fractured, twisted reality under constant time pressure.

3748630.title: Hazard Us
3748630.short_description: Can you and your friends survive this VR puzzle adventure? You'll have to think fast, communicate well and dodge traps to solve your way to victory! Keep your eyes peeled, your brains engaged and your upper lips stiff! This world is Hazard Us!

4876730.title: Petrix
4876730.short_description: An action roguelike: become a leucocyte hunting viruses, bacteria, and fungi in a petri dish, choosing a mutation path and stacking weapons to survive ever-deeper Rifts.

2988050.title: Little Red
2988050.short_description: Survive a twisted fairytale as Red Riding Hood in this intense base defence horror game. Hold the line, defend the house, and don’t let the monsters break in.

4929040.title: Pickup Point Simulator Demo
4929040.short_description: Run your own parcel pickup point and manage the daily flow of deliveries. Scan incoming packages, organize them by number, verify customer identities, and provide fast, accurate service. Grow your business, improve efficiency, and become the neighborhood's most trusted pickup point.

4784870.title: GameUP Demo
4784870.short_description: Try GameUP for free: choose an FPS objective, select a running game, capture a real gameplay scene, view results, retest the same scene, and compare runs in a focused workflow. Overlay and advanced advice are locked in this demo.

4861030.title: Father’s Curse
4861030.short_description: A horror game about a son who returns to his haunted family home after a call from his father, only to discover that dark rituals have turned the house into a place filled with spirits, danger, and darkness

4868650.title: 云来丹房 Demo
4868650.short_description: After Master left, you tend the pill room alone. Visitors bring illnesses, lies, and secrets. As an alchemy apprentice, your only support is the Compendium of Herbal Roots left by Master. With each diagnosis, you discern not just the sickness but the truth drawing closer.

4499910.title: Estellium Legends II
4499910.short_description: The gifted one must succeed no matter the cost. Survive against all threats, utilize a plethora of weapons and armor on over 100 characters in the Arena and fight your way to the end in this JRPG.

4866620.title: Transhumance
4866620.short_description: With the help of your trusty dragonfly, gather and guide your herd through many landscapes, avoiding dangers and crossing obstacles to reach the summer pastures...

4868710.title: Microcosm: Wizard Horde
4868710.short_description: 孤身法师对抗鲜活的微观世界。自动施放 25 种以上法术，闪避成千上万的敌人，成长为清屏风暴——单人或在线合作皆可。体积小巧、丝般顺滑，即使在低配 PC 和 Steam Deck 上也运行流畅。

4877150.title: Warlocks Nexus Demo
4877150.short_description: In Warlocks Nexus, your medieval realm faces an existential threat: an invasion from beyond. This isn't just about survival; it's about adaptation. Explore a fully destructible, voxel world, scavenge for resources, and craft your way through incursions.

3298430.title: Flaregate Network
3298430.short_description: A sci-fi deckbuilder with RTS-style fleet battles. Discover an epic space opera through a full story campaign, then pursue mastery in a separate roguelike mode.

4911720.title: BannerRush Demo
4911720.short_description: Banner Rush is a tactical real-time duel in which you build up your army and overrun the enemy lines with a massive assault. Fight for every lane and seal the victory in the final showdown, when every breakthrough counts double or triple.

4308440.title: Zombie Defense:Breach of The Undead
4308440.short_description: Zombie Defense: Breach of the Undead 是一款黑暗风格的波次制僵尸防御游戏。你需要建造防线，抵御无尽的亡灵大军，在越来越致命的感染者面前努力生存。

4874470.title: Cat Eats Sushi Demo
4874470.short_description: 放置寿司，引导爱吃寿司的猫咪的益智游戏。

4851820.title: Crystal Wars Demo
4851820.short_description: The Crystal Wars demo is free in your browser: the complete tutorial, Easy & Medium AI, the first campaign chapter (6 levels), and live online multiplayer. The full version adds the Hard AI (real minimax), 4 more campaign chapters, every field setting, and all 26 achievements.

4334120.title: 异界少女的轮回血契 Demo
4334120.short_description: 一场只能活下一人的游戏，一份可以实现愿望的血契，一次充满谎言与真情的相处。只有胜者才能离开，你的手上必须沾满鲜血，用他人作为代价实现自己的愿望。谁会率先为了欲望而拿起屠刀？谁会率先为了欲望而满嘴谎言？

4894160.title: Duel of Gaia Demo
4894160.short_description: 盖亚决斗》是一款以卡牌为核心的自动战斗策略游戏。选择独特的元素卡组，投身战斗。使用卡牌释放强力技能或召唤怪物，运用最佳的自动战斗策略击败对手，征服整片大陆。

3789070.title: Fractured Realms
3789070.short_description: Train classic RPG skills, build and upgrade your own outpost, and progress through a handcrafted fantasy world in this idle-style, UI-driven pixel RPG inspired by RuneScape and Melvor Idle

4692030.title: 蛆
4692030.short_description: 《蛆》是一款会检测电脑运行状态的桌面像素生态游戏。它读取 CPU、GPU、内存和温度数据，并把你的电脑状态转化为蛆群的速度、繁殖、死亡和异变。负载越高，腐肉越躁动；机器越热，蛆群越危险。每次打开，都是一场由你的电脑驱动的桌面污染。

4481560.title: CORGI & WOOLLY - Little Horizon -
4481560.short_description: 在桌面的一角，打造一片小小的草原。在屏幕边缘延伸的地平线上，柯基犬与羊群的时光静静流淌。仿佛在回应你的打字和鼠标操作，柯基犬也会像牧羊犬一样四处奔走，将羊群聚集在一起，在你的工作或学习时光中默默陪伴。这是一款常驻桌面的治愈系放置游戏。

4829980.title: 仙途放置：无尽天梯和完美装备
4829980.short_description: 一款修仙题材的放置RPG。你将扮演一名初入仙途的修士，通过挑战无尽天梯、收集神兵利器、修炼功法秘籍，逐步突破境界，最终九转成仙！ 【核心玩法】 无尽天梯 ，一亿层关卡，挂机自动战斗。九转成仙 - 9次转生系统，越转越强 🏭 生产技能 - 冥想修炼、采药炼丹、离线自动生产 【特色系统】 · 怪物梗技能 - 55种怪物各有专属热梗技能，20种Boss各有独特大招 · 异宝系统 - 不灭金身、天赐暴击、玄武真身等传说级装备 · 道树天赋 - 修罗道/玄武道/太虚道三大路线，自由搭配 · 装备评分 - 智能评分一键换装，轻松管理装备 · 多存档 - 最多8个存档槽位

4872690.title: Love Train
4872690.short_description: Love Train is a side-view roguelike shooter where you race through a ruined world swarming with monstrous creatures. Defeat enemies, collect items, survive strange events at each station, and upgrade your ordinary train into a powerful, grotesque monster train.

4797420.title: Urban assault
4797420.short_description: A competitive multiplayer first-person shooter where you shoot, flank, and dominate across Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag. Choose from 8 weapons and outplay opponents with skill-based combat and precise lag-compensated hit detection.

4282450.title: 银白钢铁X 1+2 双重收藏辑
4282450.short_description: 极限2D动作游戏《银白钢铁X》系列两部作品合二为一。 搭载所有DLC，并重新调整了游戏平衡，以导演剪辑版之姿完全新生。 此外还搭载了新模式“无尽战斗”。 这是曾经游玩过原版的玩家也能以新鲜的心情享受的特别模式。

4199030.title: RxB - Cyber security management game
4199030.short_description: RxB is a turn-based 2D game where you play as the defender (Blue). You compete against the game which takes the role as an attacker (Red).

4659040.title: 五行幻境：荒渡
4659040.short_description: 东方玄幻的Rogue-like卡牌构筑游戏 ，融合五行相克相生的策略层。每次死亡都是进步，每个角色都是全新玩法，一起来五行幻想世界的荒域冒险吧。

4752830.title: 赤马 Demo
4752830.short_description: 肉鸽地牢玩法的独立游戏，游戏特点是由真人出镜的回合制打斗，多种武学可选，可收集多名美女模特，另外包含丰富的文字剧情。
